1	# Epic 2 Context: Biometric Authentication Vault
2	
3	<!-- Compiled from planning artifacts. Edit freely. Regenerate with compile-epic-context if planning docs change. -->
4	
5	## Goal
6	
7	Put a device-validated access barrier in front of every screen that shows user data: Face ID or Touch ID with a PIN fallback, cold-start and after a fixed idle timeout, with zero lockout path and zero biometric data or call ever reaching the backend. This closes the one entry point into the app that Epic 1 left as a placeholder, and every later feature's data is only ever reachable once this gate has passed.
8	
9	## Stories
10	
11	- Story 2.1: Biometric/PIN App-Access Gate
12	- Story 2.2: Biometric-Failure Fallback to PIN
13	- Story 2.3: Fixed 5-Minute Idle Re-Authentication Timeout
14	- Story 2.4: Biometric Preference Persistence
15	
16	## Requirements & Constraints
17	
18	- No screen other than the vault/login screen is reachable before authentication succeeds, on cold start and after the idle timeout.
19	- Biometric validation is 100% on-device; no biometric data or biometric call ever reaches the backend. `AuthInvalid` can only ever originate from password login — never from a local vault/PIN check, so no vault failure is ever mapped to that Failure subtype.
20	- A failed biometric attempt always offers a PIN entry path — never a dead end, never a lockout. An OS-level lockout from repeated biometric failures is detected and routed to the app's own PIN fallback, not retried against the OS.
21	- The idle re-authentication timeout is exactly 5 minutes, fixed and not user-configurable: resuming before 5 minutes prompts nothing; resuming at or after 5 minutes always prompts re-authentication, regardless of any user setting.
22	- The biometric on/off preference is persisted server-side via `PATCH /account/settings` (surfacing the standard Failure contract on error), not cached only on-device — it is re-fetched from the account on every app load, including after reinstall. Disabling biometrics still leaves PIN as the access method; the vault itself can never be fully turned off.
23	- Performance floor applies as elsewhere: local UI interactions <100ms; any network call >300ms shows a loading indicator.
24	
25	## Technical Decisions
26	
27	- New module `features/vault/` owns this epic. It exposes a `VaultStatus` stream from `features/vault/domain`, mirroring how `features/auth/domain` exposes `SessionStatus` — registered once in DI as a singleton, same pattern, no second instance.
28	- The single `go_router` top-level redirect (already scaffolded by Epic 1/F000 for `SessionStatus`) is extended, not rebuilt: it composes exactly two gates in fixed order — `VaultStatus` first, then `SessionStatus` — because the vault gates whether anything may be shown at all, before any network/session state is considered. Neither gate ever makes a network call to validate itself.
29	- Biometrics via `local_auth` (^3.0.2); any local secret (e.g. PIN) via `flutter_secure_storage` (^11.2.0). `NSFaceIDUsageDescription` is required in `Info.plist` for Face ID (not for Touch ID). `local_auth`'s `biometryLockout`/`lockedOut` error has no programmatic reset — catch it and fall through to the app's own PIN path. `stickyAuth` behavior is relevant to resuming an in-flight check when the app returns to foreground.
30	- The 5-minute idle timeout is app logic (lifecycle observation on backgrounding/resuming), not plugin-provided, and must be implemented as a fixed parameter living inside `features/vault/domain` — explicitly not a shared `core/` constant — and is never re-tuned by any later story.
31	- The biometric preference toggle itself is persisted through `PATCH /account/settings`, which belongs to `features/account/` (not `features/vault/`) — story 2.4 is the point where a minimal Configurações screen is introduced (replacing Epic 1's placeholder) containing only this toggle; Epic 8 later extends the same screen with profile editing, dashboard, and account actions, so it is never recreated from scratch.
32	- Standard project-wide rules apply: domain layer imports neither `package:flutter` nor `data/`; repositories return `Either<Failure, T>`; no hardcoded visual values outside `design_tokens.dart`.
33	
34	## UX & Interaction Patterns
35	
36	- PIN keypad: numeric 3×4 grid + backspace, progress dots above, rendered entirely in the structural palette (no accent color on digits).
37	- PIN entry auto-advances 350ms after the 4th digit is entered — no explicit "confirm" tap.
38	- Biometric-failure copy: "Não foi possível reconhecer — digite seu PIN."
39	- Screen-reader labels must announce the failure transition (state changes, not just static state).
40	- The PIN keypad is one of the tightest-fit surfaces for Dynamic Type — digits must not truncate at the largest accessibility text size.
41	- Tap targets ≥44pt.
42	
43	## Cross-Story Dependencies
44	
45	- Depends on Epic 1/F000: the `go_router` redirect skeleton and the `SessionStatus` stream already exist (stories 1.5/1.6). This epic plugs the `VaultStatus` half into that same redirect rather than building a second, competing gate.
46	- Story 2.4 depends on `features/account/`'s `PATCH /account/settings` and introduces the Configurações screen shell that Epic 8 later extends — that screen must not be rebuilt from scratch in Epic 8.
47	- Within the epic, 2.1 (the gate itself) must exist before 2.2 (its failure fallback) and 2.3 (its timeout trigger) make sense; 2.4's persisted preference governs whether 2.1's gate is biometric-first or PIN-only, so it reads that preference at startup regardless of build order.

# Epic 2 Context: Biometric Authentication Vault

<!-- Compiled from planning artifacts. Edit freely. Regenerate with compile-epic-context if planning docs change. -->

## Goal

Put a device-validated access barrier in front of every screen that shows user data: Face ID or Touch ID with a PIN fallback, cold-start and after a fixed idle timeout, with zero lockout path and zero biometric data or call ever reaching the backend. This closes the one entry point into the app that Epic 1 left as a placeholder, and every later feature's data is only ever reachable once this gate has passed.

## Stories

- Story 2.1: Biometric/PIN App-Access Gate
- Story 2.2: Biometric-Failure Fallback to PIN
- Story 2.3: Fixed 5-Minute Idle Re-Authentication Timeout
- Story 2.4: Biometric Preference Persistence

## Requirements & Constraints

- No screen other than the vault/login screen is reachable before authentication succeeds, on cold start and after the idle timeout.
- Biometric validation is 100% on-device; no biometric data or biometric call ever reaches the backend. `AuthInvalid` can only ever originate from password login — never from a local vault/PIN check, so no vault failure is ever mapped to that Failure subtype.
- A failed biometric attempt always offers a PIN entry path — never a dead end, never a lockout. An OS-level lockout from repeated biometric failures is detected and routed to the app's own PIN fallback, not retried against the OS.
- The idle re-authentication timeout is exactly 5 minutes, fixed and not user-configurable: resuming before 5 minutes prompts nothing; resuming at or after 5 minutes always prompts re-authentication, regardless of any user setting.
- The biometric on/off preference is persisted server-side via `PATCH /account/settings` (surfacing the standard Failure contract on error), not cached only on-device — it is re-fetched from the account on every app load, including after reinstall. Disabling biometrics still leaves PIN as the access method; the vault itself can never be fully turned off.
- Performance floor applies as elsewhere: local UI interactions <100ms; any network call >300ms shows a loading indicator.

## Technical Decisions

- New module `features/vault/` owns this epic. It exposes a `VaultStatus` stream from `features/vault/domain`, mirroring how `features/auth/domain` exposes `SessionStatus` — registered once in DI as a singleton, same pattern, no second instance.
- The single `go_router` top-level redirect (already scaffolded by Epic 1/F000 for `SessionStatus`) is extended, not rebuilt: it composes exactly two gates in fixed order — `VaultStatus` first, then `SessionStatus` — because the vault gates whether anything may be shown at all, before any network/session state is considered. Neither gate ever makes a network call to validate itself.
- Biometrics via `local_auth` (^3.0.2); any local secret (e.g. PIN) via `flutter_secure_storage` (^11.2.0). `NSFaceIDUsageDescription` is required in `Info.plist` for Face ID (not for Touch ID). `local_auth`'s `biometryLockout`/`lockedOut` error has no programmatic reset — catch it and fall through to the app's own PIN path. `stickyAuth` behavior is relevant to resuming an in-flight check when the app returns to foreground.
- The 5-minute idle timeout is app logic (lifecycle observation on backgrounding/resuming), not plugin-provided, and must be implemented as a fixed parameter living inside `features/vault/domain` — explicitly not a shared `core/` constant — and is never re-tuned by any later story.
- The biometric preference toggle itself is persisted through `PATCH /account/settings`, which belongs to `features/account/` (not `features/vault/`) — story 2.4 is the point where a minimal Configurações screen is introduced (replacing Epic 1's placeholder) containing only this toggle; Epic 8 later extends the same screen with profile editing, dashboard, and account actions, so it is never recreated from scratch.
- Standard project-wide rules apply: domain layer imports neither `package:flutter` nor `data/`; repositories return `Either<Failure, T>`; no hardcoded visual values outside `design_tokens.dart`.

## UX & Interaction Patterns

- PIN keypad: numeric 3×4 grid + backspace, progress dots above, rendered entirely in the structural palette (no accent color on digits).
- PIN entry auto-advances 350ms after the 4th digit is entered — no explicit "confirm" tap.
- Biometric-failure copy: "Não foi possível reconhecer — digite seu PIN."
- Screen-reader labels must announce the failure transition (state changes, not just static state).
- The PIN keypad is one of the tightest-fit surfaces for Dynamic Type — digits must not truncate at the largest accessibility text size.
- Tap targets ≥44pt.

## Cross-Story Dependencies

- Depends on Epic 1/F000: the `go_router` redirect skeleton and the `SessionStatus` stream already exist (stories 1.5/1.6). This epic plugs the `VaultStatus` half into that same redirect rather than building a second, competing gate.
- Story 2.4 depends on `features/account/`'s `PATCH /account/settings` and introduces the Configurações screen shell that Epic 8 later extends — that screen must not be rebuilt from scratch in Epic 8.
- Within the epic, 2.1 (the gate itself) must exist before 2.2 (its failure fallback) and 2.3 (its timeout trigger) make sense; 2.4's persisted preference governs whether 2.1's gate is biometric-first or PIN-only, so it reads that preference at startup regardless of build order.

13	## Intent
14	
15	**Problem:** Epic 1 left every screen reachable with no device-level access barrier; Epic 2 requires Face ID/Touch ID (PIN fallback is Story 2.2) to block all screens except the vault/login screen, on cold start, before any data is shown.
16	
17	**Approach:** Add a `features/vault/` module exposing a `VaultStatus` stream that mirrors `features/auth/domain`'s `SessionStatus` pattern exactly, and extend the single existing `go_router` redirect so it composes `VaultStatus` first, then `SessionStatus` (the seam is already commented in-place). A new `/vault` route shows a minimal lock screen that auto-triggers the OS biometric prompt via `local_auth` and offers a manual retry on failure — no PIN entry UI (that's Story 2.2).
18	
19	## Boundaries & Constraints
20	
21	**Always:** `_redirect` checks `VaultStatus` before `SessionStatus`, never a second `GoRouter`/`redirect`. Vault makes zero network calls; `authenticate()` never produces `Failure.authInvalid` (reserved for password login). `local_auth.authenticate()` is called with `biometricOnly: true` so it never silently falls back to the OS's own device passcode screen. `VaultStatus` starts `locked` at construction (not nullable — no async warm-up needed) and only a successful `authenticate()` flips it to `unlocked`.
22	
23	**Ask First:** None — remaining technical choices (lock-screen copy, retry-button wording) are decided per AGENTS.md's "decide and proceed."
24	
25	**Never:** No PIN entry screen, no idle-timeout re-lock, no biometric-preference persistence — Stories 2.2/2.3/2.4. Never set `biometricOnly: false` (would let the OS's own passcode bypass Cerne's intended PIN flow).
26	
27	## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix
28	
29	| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
30	|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
31	| Cold start, biometrics succeed | `VaultStatus.locked`, app opened, OS prompt confirms | `authenticate()` emits `unlocked`; redirect falls through to existing `SessionStatus` logic (Home if authenticated) | N/A |
32	| Cold start, biometrics fail/cancelled/unavailable | `authenticate()` returns `false` or throws `LocalAuthException` | Status stays `locked`; lock screen shows retry button | `Left(Failure.malformedResponse(...))`, no crash |
33	| Any navigation while locked | `location != /vault`, `VaultStatus.locked` | redirect returns `/vault` | N/A |
34

39	- `lib/features/auth/domain/entities/session_status.dart`, `.../repositories/session_repository.dart`, `data/repositories/session_repository_impl.dart` — exact pattern to mirror (`Stream.multi` replay-to-late-listeners, `_emit`/`isClosed` guard, `dispose:` wiring).

---
title: 'Biometric/PIN App-Access Gate'
type: 'feature'
created: '2026-11-03'
status: 'done'
review_loop_iteration: 0
context: []
baseline_commit: 'a2b0a109edce69fb6f111084566cedc60057dd71'

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** Epic 1 left every screen reachable with no device-level access barrier; Epic 2 requires Face ID/Touch ID (PIN fallback is Story 2.2) to block all screens except the vault/login screen, on cold start, before any data is shown.

**Approach:** Add a `features/vault/` module exposing a `VaultStatus` stream that mirrors `features/auth/domain`'s `SessionStatus` pattern exactly, and extend the single existing `go_router` redirect so it composes `VaultStatus` first, then `SessionStatus` (the seam is already commented in-place). A new `/vault` route shows a minimal lock screen that auto-triggers the OS biometric prompt via `local_auth` and offers a manual retry on failure — no PIN entry UI (that's Story 2.2).

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:** `_redirect` checks `VaultStatus` before `SessionStatus`, never a second `GoRouter`/`redirect`. Vault makes zero network calls; `authenticate()` never produces `Failure.authInvalid` (reserved for password login). `local_auth.authenticate()` is called with `biometricOnly: true` so it never silently falls back to the OS's own device passcode screen. `VaultStatus` starts `locked` at construction (not nullable — no async warm-up needed) and only a successful `authenticate()` flips it to `unlocked`.

**Ask First:** None — remaining technical choices (lock-screen copy, retry-button wording) are decided per AGENTS.md's "decide and proceed."

**Never:** No PIN entry screen, no idle-timeout re-lock, no biometric-preference persistence — Stories 2.2/2.3/2.4. Never set `biometricOnly: false` (would let the OS's own passcode bypass Cerne's intended PIN flow).

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Cold start, biometrics succeed | `VaultStatus.locked`, app opened, OS prompt confirms | `authenticate()` emits `unlocked`; redirect falls through to existing `SessionStatus` logic (Home if authenticated) | N/A |
| Cold start, biometrics fail/cancelled/unavailable | `authenticate()` returns `false` or throws `LocalAuthException` | Status stays `locked`; lock screen shows retry button | `Left(Failure.malformedResponse(...))`, no crash |
| Any navigation while locked | `location != /vault`, `VaultStatus.locked` | redirect returns `/vault` | N/A |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `lib/features/auth/domain/entities/session_status.dart`, `.../repositories/session_repository.dart`, `data/repositories/session_repository_impl.dart` — exact pattern to mirror (`Stream.multi` replay-to-late-listeners, `_emit`/`isClosed` guard, `dispose:` wiring).
- `lib/core/navigation/app_router.dart:17-25` (`AppRoutePaths`), `:38-81` (`buildAppRouter`), `:94-98` (seam comment already marks this exact change), `:99-123` (`_redirect`), `:129-148` (`_GoRouterRefreshStream`, currently wraps one stream).
- `lib/main.dart:48,63-67` — `_sessionRepository = sl<SessionRepository>()` call site to mirror for vault.
- `lib/core/di/injection_container.dart:79` — `registerAuthFeature()` call site; add `registerVaultFeature()` after it.
- `lib/features/auth/auth_injection.dart` — DI registration pattern (`registerLazySingleton` + `dispose:`) to mirror.
- `lib/core/failure/failure.dart:38-39` — `Failure.malformedResponse` is the only local-failure subtype to use here.
- `pubspec.yaml:49-50` — `local_auth: ^3.0.2`, `flutter_secure_storage: ^11.2.0` already present, no change.
- `~/.pub-cache/.../local_auth-3.0.2/lib/src/local_auth.dart` — current API: `authenticate()` returns `Future<bool>`, throws `LocalAuthException` (not `PlatformException`) on error.
- `ios/Runner/Info.plist` — `NSFaceIDUsageDescription` absent, must be added.
- `test/core/navigation/app_router_test.dart` — every existing case constructs `buildAppRouter(sessionRepository: ..., ...)` directly; each call site needs a second fake `VaultRepository` (default `unlocked`) added.
- `test/main_test.dart:89-97` — `setUp` calls real `setupCoreDependencies()`; since `CerneApp` will now also resolve `sl<VaultRepository>()`, swap in a fake pre-`unlocked` one here so existing auth/session cases are unaffected.

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [x] `lib/features/vault/domain/entities/vault_status.dart` -- create `enum VaultStatus { locked, unlocked }` -- mirrors `SessionStatus`.
- [x] `lib/features/vault/domain/repositories/vault_repository.dart` -- create `abstract class VaultRepository` (`statusStream`, non-null `currentStatus` defaulting `locked`, `authenticate()`, `dispose()`) -- mirrors `SessionRepository` (RNF09: `Either<Failure, Unit>`).
- [x] `lib/features/vault/data/repositories/vault_repository_impl.dart` -- create `VaultRepositoryImpl(LocalAuthentication)`; `authenticate()` calls `.authenticate(localizedReason: ..., biometricOnly: true, persistAcrossBackgrounding: true)`; success emits `unlocked`+`right(unit)`; `false`/`LocalAuthException` -> `left(Failure.malformedResponse(...))`, status unchanged -- zero network, never `authInvalid`.
- [x] `lib/features/vault/vault_injection.dart` -- create `registerVaultFeature()` -- mirrors `auth_injection.dart`.
- [x] `lib/core/di/injection_container.dart` -- call `registerVaultFeature()` after `registerAuthFeature()`.
- [x] `lib/core/navigation/app_router.dart` -- add `vaultLock` path; thread `vaultRepository` through `buildAppRouter`/`_redirect`; new top branch returns `vaultLock` whenever status isn't `unlocked`; extend the existing authenticated/expired `location == boot || auth` check to also include `vaultLock`; extend `_GoRouterRefreshStream` to subscribe to both streams -- composes the two gates in fixed order (AD-14).
- [x] `lib/features/vault/presentation/screens/vault_lock_screen.dart` -- `StatefulWidget` calling `vaultRepository.authenticate()` once in `initState`, with a "Tentar novamente" retry button on failure -- no PIN UI; `DesignTokens` only.
- [x] `lib/main.dart` -- resolve `sl<VaultRepository>()`, pass into `buildAppRouter`.
- [x] `ios/Runner/Info.plist` -- add `NSFaceIDUsageDescription`.
- [x] `test/features/vault/data/repositories/vault_repository_impl_test.dart` -- unit-test the I/O matrix with a mocked `LocalAuthentication`.
- [x] `test/core/navigation/app_router_test.dart` -- add a fake `VaultRepository` (default `unlocked`) to every existing call site; add cases: locked overrides any `SessionStatus`; unlocked + authenticated at `/vault` routes home.
- [x] `test/main_test.dart` -- swap in a fake pre-unlocked `VaultRepository` in `setUp`; add one new test: cold start stays on `/vault` until a fake `authenticate()` success routes to Home.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given the app is cold-started, when the vault gate evaluates, then no screen other than `/vault` is reachable until `authenticate()` succeeds.
- Given the redirect evaluates on any navigation attempt, then it composes exactly two gates in fixed order (`VaultStatus` then `SessionStatus`) and neither ever makes a network call.
- Given Face ID/Touch ID is available and the user opens the app, when the OS prompt succeeds, then the app routes to Home/Chat via the existing session logic, and `features/vault/domain` exposes `VaultStatus` registered once in DI.

### Review Findings

- [x] [Review][Patch] `authenticate()` only catches `on LocalAuthException`; any other thrown exception (e.g. a platform-channel failure) escapes the `Either` contract (RNF09) unmapped and leaves `VaultLockScreen` permanently stuck on "autenticando" with no retry option — on the one gate blocking every screen in the app. The sibling `session_repository_impl.dart` this class is documented to mirror uses a broad `catch (error)` for exactly this reason. [lib/features/vault/data/repositories/vault_repository_impl.dart:96] — fixed: added a plain `catch (error)` branch mapping to `Failure.malformedResponse`.
- [x] [Review][Patch] `test/main_test.dart`'s global `setUp()` override (`sl.registerLazySingleton<VaultRepository>(() => _FakeVaultRepository())`) omits the `dispose:` callback the real registration always wires, leaking a `StreamController` for every pre-existing test case in the file. [test/main_test.dart:147] — fixed: added the `dispose:` callback.
- [x] [Review][Patch] `Semantics(liveRegion: true, ...)` is primarily honored by Android/TalkBack; on this iOS-only app, VoiceOver may not reliably announce the lock→retry transition the epic's UX notes require. Pair it with an explicit `SemanticsService.announce()` call when `_showRetry` flips, which is honored cross-platform. [lib/features/vault/presentation/screens/vault_lock_screen.dart:75] — fixed: added a `SemanticsService.sendAnnouncement()` call (the current, non-deprecated API on this Flutter version) alongside `liveRegion`.
- [x] [Review][Defer] `authenticate()`'s single `on LocalAuthException` catch collapses every `LocalAuthExceptionCode` (including `lockedOut`/`biometryLockout`) into one generic `Failure.malformedResponse`, discarding the lockout-vs-other-failure distinction `epic-2-context.md` says Story 2.2 needs to route lockouts to the PIN fallback instead of retrying the OS. [lib/features/vault/data/repositories/vault_repository_impl.dart:96] — deferred, owned by Story 2.2
- [x] [Review][Defer] No timeout wraps the OS biometric prompt; if `authenticate()` never resolves (a hung native call not covered by `persistAcrossBackgrounding`), the lock screen stays on its initial state forever with no retry button and no escape. Outside spec-2-1's own I/O matrix (success/declined/cancelled only). [lib/features/vault/presentation/screens/vault_lock_screen.dart:43] — deferred, pre-existing risk class
- [x] [Review][Defer] `main.dart`'s `restoreSession()` fires unconditionally in `initState` regardless of `VaultStatus` (unchanged since Story 1.4), in tension with `epic-2-context.md`'s own framing that the vault gates "before any network/session state is considered." [lib/main.dart:82] — deferred, pre-existing

## Design Notes

`biometricOnly: true` is the one easy-to-miss detail: `local_auth`'s default (`false`) lets the OS's own device-passcode UI satisfy `authenticate()`, which would bypass Cerne's own PIN screen (Story 2.2) entirely — `true` forces biometrics-or-fail, matching the epic's intent that PIN is Cerne's own screen, never iOS's/Android's.

`VaultStatus.currentStatus` is deliberately non-nullable (unlike `SessionStatus?`) — the vault's "locked" state is known synchronously at construction, with no async restore step, so there's no boot-loading gap to represent with `null`.

## Verification

**Commands:**
- `fvm flutter analyze` -- expected: zero issues.
- `fvm flutter test` -- expected: all pass, including new vault tests.

**Manual checks (if no CLI):**
- No device/simulator exists yet (AGENTS.md) — the real OS biometric prompt itself is unverifiable until one does; this is a known, pre-existing gap, not introduced by this story.

content.content:
**When** the vault gate evaluates
**Then** no screen other than the vault/login screen is reachable until authentication succeeds.

**Given** the `go_router` redirect
**When** it evaluates on any navigation attempt
**Then** it composes exactly two gates in fixed order — `VaultStatus` first, then `SessionStatus` (AD-14) — and neither gate ever makes a network call to validate itself; biometric validation is 100% on-device, so no biometric data or call ever reaches the backend.

**Given** Face ID/Touch ID is available and enabled
**When** I open the app
**Then** the OS biometric prompt appears and, on success, routes me straight to Home/Chat.
**And** `features/vault/domain` exposes a `VaultStatus` stream the same way `features/auth/domain` exposes `SessionStatus` (AD-8 pattern), registered once in DI.

### Story 2.2: Biometric-Failure Fallback to PIN

As a user whose biometric check fails,
I want to fall back to entering a PIN,
So that I'm never locked out of my own journal.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** Face ID/Touch ID fails to recognize me
**When** the failure is reported
**Then** "Não foi possível reconhecer — digite seu PIN" appears with a PIN entry path always reachable — never a dead end.

**Given** repeated biometric failures trigger an OS-level lockout
**When** that lockout is detected
**Then** the app routes to its own PIN fallback rather than retrying against the OS.

**Given** the PIN keypad (3×4 grid + backspace, progress dots, structural palette only, UX-DR14)
**When** I enter the 4th digit
**Then** the app auto-advances 350ms later with no explicit "confirm" tap (UX-DR27).
**And** the screen-reader announces the failure transition per the Accessibility Floor (UX-DR21), and the keypad's digits remain legible at the largest Dynamic Type size without truncation (UX-DR22).

### Story 2.3: Fixed 5-Minute Idle Re-Authentication Timeout

As a user,
I want re-authentication required only after 5 minutes backgrounded,
So that casual app-switching doesn't interrupt me but a forgotten unlocked phone stays protected.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** the app is backgrounded for less than 5 minutes
**When** I resume it
**Then** no re-authentication is prompted.

**Given** the app is backgrounded for 5 minutes or more
**When** I resume it
**Then** re-authentication is always prompted, regardless of any user setting — this value is fixed, not user-configurable.
**And** this timeout is implemented as a fixed parameter within `features/vault/domain`, not as a shared `core/` constant, and is never re-tuned by any later story.

### Story 2.4: Biometric Preference Persistence

1	/// Epic 2's device-level access gate state (AD-14 seam in
2	/// `core/navigation/app_router.dart`) — mirrors
3	/// `features/auth/domain/entities/session_status.dart`'s pattern exactly,
4	/// but for the *device* gate rather than the *session* gate.
5	///
6	/// Unlike [SessionStatus] (nullable at boot, since it needs a network round
7	/// trip to resolve), [VaultStatus] is known synchronously the instant
8	/// `VaultRepository` is constructed — [locked] is always the correct answer
9	/// before any biometric prompt has run, so there's no boot-loading gap here
10	/// to represent with a third/`null` value. Story 2.2 (PIN fallback) and
11	/// Story 2.3 (idle-timeout re-lock) are the only features allowed to add to
12	/// this enum or its emission rules — never this story.
13	enum VaultStatus { locked, unlocked }
14

1	import 'package:fpdart/fpdart.dart';
2	
3	import '../../../../core/failure/failure.dart';
4	import '../entities/vault_status.dart';
5	
6	/// The epic's ONE new DI-singleton access point for device-level access
7	/// (AD-14) — `core/navigation/app_router.dart`'s `_redirect` reads
8	/// [currentStatus] before it reads `SessionRepository.currentStatus`
9	/// (Boundaries: "`_redirect` checks `VaultStatus` before `SessionStatus`").
10	/// Mirrors `features/auth/domain/repositories/session_repository.dart`'s
11	/// shape, except [currentStatus] is never nullable (see [VaultStatus]'s own
12	/// doc) and there is no `restoreSession`-equivalent boot call — the vault
13	/// is always [VaultStatus.locked] until a successful [authenticate] call.
14	abstract class VaultRepository {
15	  /// Broadcast stream of the current vault status. Unlike
16	  /// `SessionRepository.statusStream`, this always has a value from the
17	  /// moment the repository is constructed ([VaultStatus.locked]) — a late
18	  /// subscriber still immediately replays that cached value, same
19	  /// `Stream.multi` rationale as the session repository's own stream.
20	  Stream<VaultStatus> get statusStream;
21	
22	  /// The last status emitted on [statusStream], read synchronously —
23	  /// starts at [VaultStatus.locked] (never `null`, see [VaultStatus]'s own
24	  /// doc) and only a successful [authenticate] call ever flips it to
25	  /// [VaultStatus.unlocked].
26	  VaultStatus get currentStatus;
27	
28	  /// Triggers the OS biometric prompt (`local_auth`, `biometricOnly: true`
29	  /// — Boundaries: "never set `biometricOnly: false`"). Zero network calls
30	  /// (Boundaries: "Vault makes zero network calls"); never produces
31	  /// [Failure.authInvalid] (reserved for password login) — any failure here
32	  /// (OS declines, cancels, or throws `LocalAuthException`) maps to
33	  /// [Failure.malformedResponse] instead, and [currentStatus] stays
34	  /// [VaultStatus.locked]. Only a `true` result flips [currentStatus] to
35	  /// [VaultStatus.unlocked] and emits it on [statusStream].
36	  Future<Either<Failure, Unit>> authenticate();
37	
38	  /// Releases the underlying stream resource. Wired as `get_it`'s
39	  /// `dispose:` callback on registration, so `resetCoreDependencies()`
40	  /// (`sl.reset()`) closes it instead of leaking a `StreamController` on
41	  /// every test teardown.
42	  Future<void> dispose();
43	}
44

1	import 'dart:async';
2	
3	import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
4	import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
5	
6	import '../di/injection_container.dart';
7	import '../../features/auth/domain/entities/session_status.dart';
8	import '../../features/auth/domain/repositories/session_repository.dart';
9	import '../../features/auth/presentation/cubit/auth_cubit.dart';
10	import '../../features/auth/presentation/screens/auth_screen.dart';
11	import '../../features/vault/domain/entities/vault_status.dart';
12	import '../../features/vault/domain/repositories/vault_repository.dart';
13	import '../../features/vault/presentation/screens/vault_lock_screen.dart';
14	import 'placeholder_screens.dart';
15	
16	/// Every route this app shell resolves — Story 1.6's original set
17	/// (`/boot`, `/auth`, `/reauth`, `/`, `/meus-registros`, `/planos-de-acao`,
18	/// `/configuracoes`) plus Epic 2/spec-2-1's `/vault` lock screen. Named
19	/// constants so no call site retypes a path literal that could drift from
20	/// the one `GoRouter` below.
21	abstract final class AppRoutePaths {
22	  static const boot = '/boot';
23	  static const auth = '/auth';
24	  static const reauth = '/reauth';
25	  static const vaultLock = '/vault';
26	  static const home = '/';
27	  static const meusRegistros = '/meus-registros';
28	  static const planosDeAcao = '/planos-de-acao';
29	  static const configuracoes = '/configuracoes';
30	}
31	
32	/// The epic's ONE `GoRouter`/`redirect` (Boundaries: "never a second
33	/// competing `redirect`") — composes [VaultRepository.currentStatus] first,
34	/// then [SessionRepository.currentStatus] (AD-14). Both repositories are
35	/// taken as parameters (rather than this file reaching into `sl` itself)
36	/// purely so a test can pass fakes/mocks directly, without touching the
37	/// global DI container.
38	///
39	/// [navigatorKey] is accepted explicitly (rather than letting `GoRouter`
40	/// generate its own internally) so the caller — `main.dart`'s
41	/// `ExpiryOverlayHost` — can reach the Navigator's own `BuildContext`
42	/// through the same, public, documented key instead of reaching into
43	/// `GoRouter`'s internal `routerDelegate` (not part of its public API).
44	GoRouter buildAppRouter({
45	  required VaultRepository vaultRepository,
46	  required SessionRepository sessionRepository,
47	  required GlobalKey<NavigatorState> navigatorKey,
48	}) {
49	  return GoRouter(
50	    navigatorKey: navigatorKey,
51	    initialLocation: AppRoutePaths.boot,
52	    refreshListenable: _GoRouterRefreshStream([
53	      vaultRepository.statusStream,
54	      sessionRepository.statusStream,
55	    ]),
56	    redirect: (context, state) =>
57	        _redirect(vaultRepository, sessionRepository, state),
58	    routes: [
59	      GoRoute(
60	        path: AppRoutePaths.vaultLock,
61	        builder: (context, state) =>
62	            VaultLockScreen(vaultRepository: vaultRepository),
63	      ),
64	      GoRoute(
65	        path: AppRoutePaths.boot,
66	        builder: (context, state) => const BootSplashScreen(),
67	      ),
68	      GoRoute(
69	        path: AppRoutePaths.auth,
70	        builder: (context, state) => AuthScreen(
71	          cubit: sl<AuthCubit>(),
72	          onAuthenticated: (context) => context.go(AppRoutePaths.home),
73	        ),
74	      ),
75	      GoRoute(
76	        path: AppRoutePaths.reauth,
77	        builder: (context, state) => const BiometricReauthPlaceholderScreen(),
78	      ),
79	      GoRoute(
80	        path: AppRoutePaths.home,
81	        builder: (context, state) => const HomeChatPlaceholderScreen(),
82	      ),
83	      GoRoute(
84	        path: AppRoutePaths.meusRegistros,
85	        builder: (context, state) => const MeusRegistrosPlaceholderScreen(),
86	      ),
87	      GoRoute(
88	        path: AppRoutePaths.planosDeAcao,
89	        builder: (context, state) => const ActionPlansPlaceholderScreen(),
90	      ),
91	      GoRoute(
92	        path: AppRoutePaths.configuracoes,
93	        builder: (context, state) => const ConfiguracoesPlaceholderScreen(),
94	      ),
95	    ],
96	  );
97	}
98	
99	/// I/O & Edge-Case Matrix:
100	/// - status not yet known (`null`) -> `/boot`, unless already there.
101	/// - `unauthenticated` -> `/auth`, unless already there.
102	/// - `authenticated`/`expired` -> leaves `/boot`/`/auth` for `/`; every
103	///   other location is left alone *except* `/reauth` while already
104	///   `authenticated` (bounced home below — `/reauth` is meant to be
105	///   reached only by the expiry overlay's own explicit navigation while
106	///   `expired`, code review Story 1.6) — a mid-session expiry never
107	///   navigates away (Story 1.5 behavior preserved), and the three
108	///   non-Home destinations stay reachable while `expired`.
109	///
110	/// AD-14: Epic 2's `VaultStatus` gate (RF03) is composed first, strictly
111	/// ahead of every `SessionStatus` check below — the vault gate overrides
112	/// any location whenever it isn't `unlocked`, and only once it is does the
113	/// rest of this function (unchanged from Story 1.6) ever run.
114	String? _redirect(
115	  VaultRepository vaultRepository,
116	  SessionRepository sessionRepository,
117	  GoRouterState state,
118	) {
119	  final location = state.matchedLocation;
120	
121	  // AD-14 — checked before SessionStatus, per Boundaries ("`_redirect`
122	  // checks `VaultStatus` before `SessionStatus`"). `VaultStatus.locked` is
123	  // the default from construction (never `null`), so this never waits on
124	  // an async warm-up the way the `status == null` boot check below does.
125	  if (vaultRepository.currentStatus != VaultStatus.unlocked) {
126	    return location == AppRoutePaths.vaultLock
127	        ? null
128	        : AppRoutePaths.vaultLock;
129	  }
130	
131	  final status = sessionRepository.currentStatus;
132	
133	  if (status == null) {
134	    return location == AppRoutePaths.boot ? null : AppRoutePaths.boot;
135	  }
136	
137	  if (status == SessionStatus.unauthenticated) {
138	    return location == AppRoutePaths.auth ? null : AppRoutePaths.auth;
139	  }
140	
141	  // status is authenticated or expired.
142	  // `vaultLock` is included here too: once the vault unlocks while this
143	  // location is still `/vault` (the normal cold-start path once
144	  // `authenticate()` succeeds), the same fall-through that already bounces
145	  // `/boot`/`/auth` to Home applies — `/vault` is never a valid resting
146	  // place once `VaultStatus.unlocked`.
147	  if (location == AppRoutePaths.boot ||
148	      location == AppRoutePaths.auth ||
149	      location == AppRoutePaths.vaultLock) {
150	    return AppRoutePaths.home;
151	  }
152	  // `/reauth` is a throwaway placeholder standing in for Epic 2's real
153	  // reauth flow; it should never be sitting open once the session is back
154	  // to fully `authenticated` (code review, Story 1.6).
155	  if (location == AppRoutePaths.reauth &&
156	      status == SessionStatus.authenticated) {
157	    return AppRoutePaths.home;
158	  }
159	  return null;
160	}
161	
162	/// Wraps [streams] as a single `Listenable` so `GoRouter`'s
163	/// `refreshListenable` can re-run [_redirect] on every emission from either
164	/// one — go_router 18.1.1 exports no `GoRouterRefreshStream` of its own
165	/// (Code Map), so this is that small local class. Extended by AD-14 to
166	/// subscribe to both the vault and the session streams (previously just
167	/// the one session stream), composing them into the one `Listenable`
168	/// `GoRouter` itself requires (Boundaries: "never a second
169	/// `GoRouter`/`redirect`").
170	class _GoRouterRefreshStream extends ChangeNotifier {
171	  _GoRouterRefreshStream(Iterable<Stream<dynamic>> streams) {
172	    _subscriptions = [
173	      for (final stream in streams)
174	        stream.listen(
175	          (_) => notifyListeners(),
176	          // Mirrors `ExpiryOverlayHost`'s and `SessionRepositoryImpl`'s own
177	          // subscriptions to this same stream — no current implementation
178	          // ever errors on it, but a future one that did must not surface
179	          // as an unhandled zone exception here specifically.
180	          onError: (_, _) {},
181	        ),
182	    ];
183	  }
184	
185	  late final List<StreamSubscription<dynamic>> _subscriptions;
186	
187	  @override
188	  void dispose() {
189	    for (final subscription in _subscriptions) {
190	      subscription.cancel();
191	    }
192	    super.dispose();
193	  }
194	}
195

1	import 'package:freezed_annotation/freezed_annotation.dart';
2	
3	part 'failure.freezed.dart';
4	
5	/// AD-3 — the one closed `Failure` hierarchy, exactly 14 subtypes: the 13
6	/// codes from `docs/input/backend/error-taxonomy.md` plus the local-only
7	/// `malformedResponse` (client-side parse failure, never sent by the
8	/// backend). Never redefined or subset per feature; every repository method
9	/// returns `Either<Failure, T>` built from this type (RNF09).
10	///
11	/// `retryable` is derived here, once, from the 6 server `retryable:true`
12	/// codes (AD-4) — no other file re-decides which codes retry.
13	@freezed
14	sealed class Failure with _$Failure {
15	  const factory Failure.authExpired({required String message}) = AuthExpired;
16	  const factory Failure.authInvalid({required String message}) = AuthInvalid;
17	  const factory Failure.networkTimeout({required String message}) =
18	      NetworkTimeout;
19	  const factory Failure.networkOffline({required String message}) =
20	      NetworkOffline;
21	  const factory Failure.validation({required String message}) = Validation;
22	  const factory Failure.piiCheckFailed({required String message}) =
23	      PiiCheckFailed;
24	  const factory Failure.embeddingFailed({required String message}) =
25	      EmbeddingFailed;
26	  const factory Failure.aiGenerationTimeout({required String message}) =
27	      AiGenerationTimeout;
28	  const factory Failure.notFound({required String message}) = NotFound;
29	  const factory Failure.rateLimited({required String message}) = RateLimited;

5:  - _bmad-output/planning-artifacts/architecture/architecture-cerne-ciclo-b-2026-10-26/ARCHITECTURE-SPINE.md
14:This document provides the complete epic and story breakdown for Cerne, decomposing the requirements from the PRD, UX Design contract, and Architecture Spine into implementable stories.
22:- FR-1: Account creation and authentication — signup, login, silent refresh/session-check, all round-tripping through the backend and surfacing the Failure contract on error; a valid session persists across app restarts without re-prompting. `[ASSUMPTION]` signup collects email + password only (PRD OQ-2).
23:- FR-2: Expired-session recovery overlay — a "Sessão expirada" overlay appears over the current screen (never navigates away) when the backend reports an expired session; "Entrar novamente" routes to the biometric/PIN re-auth flow (RF03), not a login form; screen state/scroll position preserved underneath.
28:- FR-4: App-access gate — Face ID/Touch ID/PIN required before any user data is shown, on cold start and after the idle timeout (FR-6); no biometric data or call ever reaches the backend.
29:- FR-5: Biometric-failure fallback to PIN — a failed biometric attempt always offers a reachable PIN path; never locks the user out; an OS-level lockout is detected and routed to the app's own PIN fallback.
31:- FR-7: Biometric preference persistence — enable/disable biometric gating is saved via `PATCH /account/settings`, survives restarts and reinstalls (fetched from account, not cached locally only); disabling biometrics still leaves PIN as the access method.
99:- RNF02 (PII handling) `[inherited, not verified by this delivery]`: PII stripping runs server-side via a Claude Haiku 4.5 structured prompt/tool-use step.
110:*(from the Architecture Spine — cross-unit invariants and stack decisions that bound how stories must be implemented; binds column shows which build units each rule applies to)*
129:- Stack pins (binding on F000, verified at scaffold time): Flutter SDK 3.47.x stable family (exact patch pinned via `fvm`), `flutter_bloc` ^9.1.1, `go_router` ^18.1.1, `dio` ^5.11.1, `hive_ce`/`hive_ce_flutter` ^2.22.0, `get_it` ^9.3.0, `fpdart` ^1.2.0, `freezed`/`freezed_annotation` ^4.0.3, `json_serializable` ^6.15.2, `build_runner` (latest compatible), `mocktail` ^1.0.5, `fl_chart` ^1.3.0, `local_auth` ^3.0.2, `flutter_secure_storage` ^11.2.0, `flutter_dotenv` ^6.0.1, `whisper_ggml` ^2.8.1.
148:- UX-DR5: Insight card component — ochre spine on the left edge (the only accent-colored element inside the chat stream), mono "INSIGHT" label, dismiss "x."
149:- UX-DR6: Bookmark button component — four states (idle/saving/saved/error) on every user message only, never on AI responses; state carried by icon + color together, never color alone; tapping an already-`saved` message is a no-op; `error` returns to a retryable idle-like state.

231 docs/input/prototype/prototype-extract.md
# Cerne — Prototype extract

The visual reference of the product is `cerne-prototype.html` (this folder). Open it in a browser; it needs JavaScript. This extract lists its navigable states, its visual tokens, its components and the implementation notes that come with it.

- **Frame:** 390 × 844 logical points, portrait only, 4 dp grid.
- **Language of the interface:** Portuguese. Every UI text below appears exactly as in the prototype, in quotes.
- **Precedence:** the prototype defines appearance and states. Behavior rules (triggers, timings, filters, error handling) are defined in `docs/input/requirements.md`; where the prototype's simulated behavior differs from a requirement, the requirement prevails.

---

## 1. Navigation map

The prototype has **32 navigable states**, reachable from a single state machine (a `screen` variable plus overlay flags). Not every state is a new full screen — several are **overlays** (modal, sheet, bottom sheet, dialog) shown on top of one of three base screens: **Home/Chat**, **Meus Registros** and **Configurações**. Overlays preserve the screen underneath (it stays visible, with a darkened scrim behind).


## 4. Special states that need extra care

- **Expired session:** an overlay on the chat that keeps history and scroll position — the expired token must not discard the conversation state in memory before re-authentication. Re-authenticating goes back to the Biometria screen, not to a full form.
- **Offline:** blocks **sending new messages** (send icon disabled, explanatory banner), but **history stays visible and navigable**. The prototype does not show what happens to the insertion modal (text/audio/photo) when offline.
- **Asynchronous processing — audio transcription:** a loading state (spinner + frozen waveform) and two outcomes (success/error); the error always offers "Tentar novamente" and never loses the recorded audio.
- **Asynchronous processing — photo OCR:** same pattern as audio, with one extra exit on error: "Salvar só a foto", which saves the record even without extracted text.
- **Asynchronous processing — export:** two loading stages (preparing → generating the AI summary) before the result; on error, the raw data is always available for download — the failure is isolated to the AI narrative, never to the user's data.
- **Dashboard narrative unavailable:** the chart loads normally but the AI summary paragraph fails — distinct from "zero entries" (lack of data) and needs its own error message.

---

## 5. Implementation notes

1. **"29 frames" vs. "32 states":** the prototype has 32 distinct navigable states, but the number of frames (29) suggests that some state families should be one screen with internal state, not separate routes (e.g., a single `ExportSheet` with a status enum instead of 5 routes). Consider this when designing navigation.
2. **Account deletion without a success screen:** both "Sair" and "Apagar tudo" return to the Biometria screen; there is no "account deleted" or "you signed out" screen.
3. **Login vs. sign-up:** the same screen toggled by a text link; the prototype shows no extra sign-up fields (e.g., password confirmation, name). Whether sign-up needs extra fields is a product decision not covered visually.
4. **Insertion modal when offline:** not represented.
5. **Switching tabs in the insertion modal:** opening the modal always resets every tab to `idle`/empty, but switching tabs *during* a modal session is not cleared automatically — the expected behavior (e.g., whether an ongoing recording is discarded on tab switch) is not defined by the prototype.
6. **Per-entry sync indicator:** the states "sincronizado / sincronizando / erro de sync" exist visually on the cards, but no explicit "retry sync" action is shown for the error state. The semantics of the badge are in `docs/input/backend/sync-badge.md`.
7. **Text search combined with filters:** the filter sheet and the text search are on the same screen, but the prototype does not show them acting together.

| Tela 4 — Sheet de filtro | Groups "INTERVALO DE DATA" (Todo o período / Esta semana / Este mês, single choice), "CATEGORIA" (chips: trabalho, rotina, descanso, relações), "TIPO DE ENTRADA" (chips: manual, áudio, foto, chat); "Aplicar" and "Limpar". **Note:** the backend has no category filter (requirements, RF06); categories are the tags extension. |

### 2.5 Export (bottom sheet over Tela 4; 5 states)
| State | What it shows |
|---|---|
| Pendente | Spinner, "Preparando exportação...". |
| Processando | "Gerando resumo com IA...", progress bar. |
| Concluído | Green check, "Resumo pronto", buttons "Baixar PDF" (primary) and "Baixar dados brutos" (outline). |
| Erro | Red warning; text explaining that the AI narrative failed but the data remains available; only the button "Baixar dados brutos". |
| Período vazio | "Nenhum registro nesse período." and a suggestion to adjust the filter; no download button. |

All five have the link "Fechar" at the bottom. The mapping between these states and the backend job statuses is in `docs/input/backend/export-screen-states.md`.

### 2.6 Plans and settings
| State | What it shows |
|---|---|
| Tela 5 — Planos de Ação **[ext]** | Three horizontally scrolling columns — "A Fazer", "Em Andamento", "Concluído" — with counts and cards. |
| Tela 6 — Configurações — mais de 30 registros | "Sua evolução": 10-bar ochre chart + summary paragraph. |
| Tela 6 — Configurações — uma entrada | A single small bar and the text "Ainda é cedo pra ver um padrão — volte em alguns dias." |
| Tela 6 — Configurações — zero entradas | Light-gray chart icon in place of the chart and "Comece a registrar para ver sua evolução aqui"; no summary paragraph. |
| Tela 6 — Configurações — narrativa indisponível | Chart with data, but the AI summary paragraph failed — needs its own error message, not just missing text. |
| Tela 6 — Confirmar exclusão de conta | Centered dialog, red title "Apagar sua conta?", text on permanent, irreversible deletion; red button "Apagar tudo"; outline "Cancelar". |

Other elements of Configurações: avatar with editable name/e-mail (pencil becomes a check in edit mode — inline editing); persona cards "Como a IA responde" (Analítico, Empático, Socrático) **[ext]**; actions "Sair" and "Apagar conta" (red).

---

## 3. Visual system (tokens for `design_tokens.dart`)

The prototype has a **Design Tokens** panel, marked as the ground truth for `design_tokens.dart`. Its names and values are below.

### Colors
| Token | Hex | Use (as stated in the panel) |
|---|---|---|
| `colorPrimary` | `#1F3D34` | Buttons, app bar, wordmark |
| `colorPrimaryPressed` | `#16281F` | Pressed state |
| `colorOnPrimary` | `#F5F1E8` | Text on primary |
| `colorAccent` | `#C98A3E` | CTA, insight, saved bookmark |
| `colorOnAccent` | `#241C0D` | Text on accent |
| `colorSecondary` | `#7C8B6F` | Tags, chips, synchronizing |
| `colorSurfaceBg` | `#F2EFE7` | General background ("paper") |
| `colorSurfaceElevated` | `#FBF9F4` | Cards, bubbles, sheets |
| `colorBorder` | `#E1DACB` | Dividers, borders |
| `colorTextPrimary` | `#241F19` | Main text |
| `colorTextSecondary` | `#6B6255` | Secondary text |
| `colorError` | `#B3402A` | Errors, destructive action |
| `colorSuccess` | `#4C6B4F` | Synchronized, confirmations |
| `colorWarningSync` | `#C98A3E` | "Synchronizing" badge |
| `colorInfoOffline` | `#5C7A93` | Offline banner — single use |

Other colors that appear on specific screens but not in the panel: user chat bubble `#D9DFD3`; text on category chips `#3F4A38`.

### Typography
| Token | Font · weight · size/line-height | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `textDisplayLg` | Fraunces 600 · 32/38 | Splash wordmark |
| `textHeadlineMd` | Fraunces 600 · 24/30 | Section titles |
| `textTitleLg` | Karla 700 · 20/26 | App bar title |
| `textTitleSm` | Karla 700 · 16/22 | Subtitles |
| `textBodyLg` | Karla 400 · 16/24 | Bubbles, entries |
| `textBodyMd` | Karla 400 · 14/20 | Secondary text and descriptions |
| `textLabelMd` | Karla 500 · 13/18 | Button text, chips |
| `textMonoCaption` | IBM Plex Mono 500 · 12/16 · letter-spacing .2 | Technical metadata (timestamps, counters, status labels) |

### Spacing (4 dp grid)
`spacingXs` 4 · `spacingSm` 8 · `spacingMd` 16 · `spacingLg` 24 · `spacingXl` 32 · `spacing2xl` 48 (dp).

### Radii
`radiusSm` 8 dp (inputs, chips) · `radiusMd` 16 dp (cards, bubbles) · `radiusLg` 24 dp (sheets, modals) · `radiusFull` 999 dp (avatars, pills).

### Elevation
`elevation1` — `0 1px 3px rgba(36,31,25,.08)` (cards at rest) · `elevation2` — `0 4px 16px rgba(36,31,25,.14)` (sheets, modals).

### Icons
Phosphor library, Regular style, 24 dp: `list`, `plus`, `magnifying-glass`, `funnel`, `bookmark-simple`, `microphone`, `camera`, `gear`, `kanban`, `notebook`, `fingerprint`, `lightbulb` (and others used on specific screens: `check`, `warning-circle`, `wifi-slash`, `circle-notch`, `caret-left`, `download-simple`, `pencil-simple`, `x`, `stop`, `image`, `check-circle`, `chart-line-up`, `backspace`, `lock-key`, `paper-plane-tilt`, `chat-circle-text`).

### Spine (colored bar on the left of a card) — 3 contexts
1. Proactive insight in the chat — ochre.
2. Entry origin in "Meus Registros" — color by type: manual = dark green, audio = olive green, photo = gray, chat = ochre.
3. Kanban column in "Planos de Ação" — color by column **[ext]**.

### Micro-animations and transitions
- `scrimIn` (0.18 s ease-out): fade of the darkened background when any overlay opens.
- `sheetUp` (0.2 s ease-out): bottom sheets (insertion modal, filter, export) rise from the bottom of the screen.
- Continuous spinner (`spin`, 1 s linear infinite) in every loading state.
- Text streaming: the AI response is revealed progressively, with a blinking cursor at the end while it is "typing".
- PIN: after the 4th digit, a 350 ms pause before navigating.

---

## 4. Special states that need extra care

- **Expired session:** an overlay on the chat that keeps history and scroll position — the expired token must not discard the conversation state in memory before re-authentication. Re-authenticating goes back to the Biometria screen, not to a full form.
- **Offline:** blocks **sending new messages** (send icon disabled, explanatory banner), but **history stays visible and navigable**. The prototype does not show what happens to the insertion modal (text/audio/photo) when offline.
- **Asynchronous processing — audio transcription:** a loading state (spinner + frozen waveform) and two outcomes (success/error); the error always offers "Tentar novamente" and never loses the recorded audio.
- **Asynchronous processing — photo OCR:** same pattern as audio, with one extra exit on error: "Salvar só a foto", which saves the record even without extracted text.
- **Asynchronous processing — export:** two loading stages (preparing → generating the AI summary) before the result; on error, the raw data is always available for download — the failure is isolated to the AI narrative, never to the user's data.
- **Dashboard narrative unavailable:** the chart loads normally but the AI summary paragraph fails — distinct from "zero entries" (lack of data) and needs its own error message.

---

## 5. Implementation notes

1. **"29 frames" vs. "32 states":** the prototype has 32 distinct navigable states, but the number of frames (29) suggests that some state families should be one screen with internal state, not separate routes (e.g., a single `ExportSheet` with a status enum instead of 5 routes). Consider this when designing navigation.
2. **Account deletion without a success screen:** both "Sair" and "Apagar tudo" return to the Biometria screen; there is no "account deleted" or "you signed out" screen.
3. **Login vs. sign-up:** the same screen toggled by a text link; the prototype shows no extra sign-up fields (e.g., password confirmation, name). Whether sign-up needs extra fields is a product decision not covered visually.
4. **Insertion modal when offline:** not represented.
5. **Switching tabs in the insertion modal:** opening the modal always resets every tab to `idle`/empty, but switching tabs *during* a modal session is not cleared automatically — the expected behavior (e.g., whether an ongoing recording is discarded on tab switch) is not defined by the prototype.
6. **Per-entry sync indicator:** the states "sincronizado / sincronizando / erro de sync" exist visually on the cards, but no explicit "retry sync" action is shown for the error state. The semantics of the badge are in `docs/input/backend/sync-badge.md`.
7. **Text search combined with filters:** the filter sheet and the text search are on the same screen, but the prototype does not show them acting together.

---

## 6. Component library

| Component | Where it appears | Variations |
|---|---|---|
| Primary button | Auth, modals, sheets, confirmations | normal (`#1F3D34`) · pressed (`#16281F`, darker) · disabled (`#E1DACB` background, `#6B6255` text) |
| Secondary button (outline) | "Tentar novamente", "Cancelar", "Baixar dados brutos" | `#1F3D34` outline, no fill |
| Text button (ghost) | Mode-toggle links, "Fechar", "Limpar" | no background, `#1F3D34` or `#6B6255` depending on context |
| Text field | Login, Texto tab, name editing | empty · focused (1.5px `#1F3D34` border) · error (`#B3402A` border) |
| Chat bubble | Home/Chat | user (light green, straight bottom-right corner) · AI (ivory with shadow, straight bottom-left corner) · streaming (pulsing cursor at the end of the text) |
| Insight card | Home/Chat | ochre spine, mono label "INSIGHT", dismiss button |
| Bookmark button (RF10) | User messages in the chat | idle (outline) · saving (spinner) · saved (ochre check) · error (red warning) |
| Send-error banner | Home/Chat | "Não foi possível enviar — toque para tentar novamente"; background `rgba(179,64,42,.08)`, warning icon, red text |
| Offline banner | Home/Chat | blue-gray background `#5C7A93`, `ph-wifi-slash` icon, light text |
| Sync badge | Record cards (Tela 4) | synced (green dot) · synchronizing (ochre dot) · sync error (red dot) |
| Filter chip | Filter sheet, active filters | single choice (date) · multiple choice (category, type) · removable with "x" (active filters) |
| Record card | Tela 4 | spine colored by origin (manual = dark green, audio = olive green, photo = gray, chat = ochre) |
| Kanban card **[ext]** | Planos de Ação | spine by column (to do / in progress / done) |
| Initials avatar | Side menu, Configurações | dark green circle, 1–2 uppercase initials, two sizes (40px in the menu, 52px in Configurações) |
| AI persona card **[ext]** | Configurações | not selected (thin border) · selected (thick `#1F3D34` border + check icon) |
| Bar chart (dashboard) | Configurações | populated (10 bars) · one bar · empty (placeholder icon) |
| Export status card | Tela 4 (bottom sheet) | pending · processing · done · error · empty |
| Confirmation dialog | Sessão expirada, Confirmar exclusão | background scrim + centered card; neutral title (session) or red title (destructive deletion) |
| PIN keypad | Tela 0.1b/c | digits 0–9 + backspace; progress dots above |
| Tab bar | Insertion modal | 3 tabs (Texto/Áudio/Foto), active tab with filled background |
| Audio waveform | Insertion modal, Áudio tab | active/animated (recording) · frozen and faded (processing) |
| Skeleton | Any content loaded over the network | shown for calls longer than 300 ms (RNF01) |

---
title: 'Biometric-Failure Fallback to PIN'
type: 'feature'
created: '2026-11-03'
status: 'draft'
review_loop_iteration: 0
context: []
---

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** Spec-2-1's `/vault` lock screen offers only a "Tentar novamente" biometric-retry button on failure — no PIN entry exists yet, so a biometric decline, cancel, or OS-level lockout currently has no real fallback, in tension with the epic's "never locks the user out" requirement.

**Approach:** Replace that interim retry button with a real PIN keypad (prototype Tela 0.1b/0.1c): any biometric failure (decline, cancel, or `LocalAuthExceptionCode.temporaryLockout`/`biometricLockout`) now falls through to the keypad with the failure copy, and a new "Usar PIN" link lets the user reach it directly from the biometric view. Neither docs/input/ nor the prototype define a PIN-creation screen, so (AGENTS.md "decide and proceed"): the first 4-digit entry when no PIN is stored becomes the stored PIN (set-on-first-use); later entries are verified against it.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:** Every `authenticate()` failure (any `LocalAuthException` code, including lockout, or a `false` result) transitions the lock screen to the PIN keypad+error band — never a second OS retry affordance (AC2). `submitPin` success emits `VaultStatus.unlocked` exactly like `authenticate()` success; no new `VaultStatus` value. PIN digits are compared as plain strings read from/written to `flutter_secure_storage` (already Keychain-encrypted) — no new hashing dependency (not in the pinned stack). PIN entry never has an attempt cap or lockout of its own — always retryable. Keypad uses the structural palette only (no `colorAccent` on digits), 4 progress dots, auto-advances 350ms after the 4th digit, ≥44pt tap targets, no truncation at the largest Dynamic Type size (UX-DR14/21/22).

**Ask First:** None.

**Never:** No PIN-confirmation second entry (prototype shows none). Never store the PIN anywhere but `flutter_secure_storage`. Never reintroduce the old "Tentar novamente" biometric button. Out of scope: idle-timeout re-lock (2.3), biometric-preference persistence (2.4).

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Biometric fails (decline/cancel/any `LocalAuthException`, incl. lockout) | `authenticate()` returns `Left` | Screen shows PIN keypad + "Não foi possível reconhecer — digite seu PIN"; screen-reader announces the transition | N/A |
| User taps "Usar PIN" from the biometric view | tap, no prior failure | PIN keypad shown, no error band | N/A |
| `submitPin`, no PIN stored yet | 4 digits entered | Stored as the new PIN, `unlocked`, `Right(unit)` | N/A |
| `submitPin`, stored PIN matches | 4 digits entered | `unlocked`, `Right(unit)` | N/A |
| `submitPin`, stored PIN mismatch | 4 digits entered | Stays `locked`, keypad clears for another attempt — never a dead end | `Left(Failure.malformedResponse(...))` |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

**Approach:** Replace that interim retry button with a real PIN keypad (prototype Tela 0.1b/0.1c): any biometric failure (decline, cancel, or `LocalAuthExceptionCode.temporaryLockout`/`biometricLockout`) now falls through to the keypad with the failure copy, and a new "Usar PIN" link lets the user reach it directly from the biometric view. ## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:** Every `authenticate()` failure (any `LocalAuthException` code, including lockout, or a `false` result) transitions the lock screen to the PIN keypad+error band — never a second OS retry affordance (AC2). `submitPin` success emits `VaultStatus.unlocked` exactly like `authenticate()` success; no new `VaultStatus` value. **Ask First:** None.

**Never:** No PIN-confirmation second entry (prototype shows none). Never store the PIN anywhere but `flutter_secure_storage`. Never reintroduce the old "Tentar novamente" biometric button. Out of scope: idle-timeout re-lock (2.3), biometric-preference persistence (2.4).

title: 'Biometric-Failure Fallback to PIN'
type: 'feature'
created: '2026-11-03'
status: 'draft'

context: []

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** Spec-2-1's `/vault` lock screen offers only a "Tentar novamente" biometric-retry button on failure — no PIN entry exists yet, so a biometric decline, cancel, or OS-level lockout currently has no real fallback, in tension with the epic's "never locks the user out" requirement.

**Approach:** Replace that interim retry button with a real PIN keypad (prototype Tela 0.1b/0.1c): any biometric failure (decline, cancel, or `LocalAuthExceptionCode.temporaryLockout`/`biometricLockout`) now falls through to the keypad with the failure copy, and a new "Usar PIN" link lets the user reach it directly from the biometric view. Neither docs/input/ nor the prototype define a PIN-creation screen, so (AGENTS.md "decide and proceed"): the first 4-digit entry when no PIN is stored becomes the stored PIN (set-on-first-use); later entries are verified against it.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:** Every `authenticate()` failure (any `LocalAuthException` code, including lockout, or a `false` result) transitions the lock screen to the PIN keypad+error band — never a second OS retry affordance (AC2). `submitPin` success emits `VaultStatus.unlocked` exactly like `authenticate()` success; no new `VaultStatus` value. PIN digits are compared as plain strings read from/written to `flutter_secure_storage` (already Keychain-encrypted) — no new hashing dependency (not in the pinned stack). PIN entry never has an attempt cap or lockout of its own — always retryable. Keypad uses the structural palette only (no `colorAccent` on digits), 4 progress dots, auto-advances 350ms after the 4th digit, ≥44pt tap targets, no truncation at the largest Dynamic Type size (UX-DR14/21/22).

**Ask First:** None.

**Never:** No PIN-confirmation second entry (prototype shows none). Never store the PIN anywhere but `flutter_secure_storage`. Never reintroduce the old "Tentar novamente" biometric button. Out of scope: idle-timeout re-lock (2.3), biometric-preference persistence (2.4).

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Biometric fails (decline/cancel/any `LocalAuthException`, incl. lockout) | `authenticate()` returns `Left` | Screen shows PIN keypad + "Não foi possível reconhecer — digite seu PIN"; screen-reader announces the transition | N/A |
| User taps "Usar PIN" from the biometric view | tap, no prior failure | PIN keypad shown, no error band | N/A |
| `submitPin`, no PIN stored yet | 4 digits entered | Stored as the new PIN, `unlocked`, `Right(unit)` | N/A |
| `submitPin`, stored PIN matches | 4 digits entered | `unlocked`, `Right(unit)` | N/A |
| `submitPin`, stored PIN mismatch | 4 digits entered | Stays `locked`, keypad clears for another attempt — never a dead end | `Left(Failure.malformedResponse(...))` |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `lib/features/vault/domain/repositories/vault_repository.dart` — add `Future<Either<Failure, Unit>> submitPin(String pin)` to the contract.

- `lib/features/auth/data/datasources/secure_storage_access_token_provider.dart` — exact `_storage.read(key:)`/`.write(key:,value:)` pattern to mirror.
- `lib/core/design_tokens.dart` — add PIN-keypad-only constants (digit button size, dot size/gap) under a new documented section; prototype-extract.md §3/§6 names the component but not its exact px.
- `lib/features/vault/presentation/widgets/pin_keypad.dart` (new) — self-contained 3×4 grid + backspace + 4 progress dots; owns its own digit buffer; clears and calls `onSubmit(pin)` 350ms after the 4th digit (prototype-extract.md §3).
- `lib/features/vault/presentation/screens/vault_lock_screen.dart` — remove the "Tentar novamente" `AppButton`; add "Usar PIN" ghost link (`AppButtonVariant.textGhost`, mirrors `auth_screen.dart`'s toggle link); add PIN-mode view (`PinKeypad` + conditional error band); wire `submitPin`; extend the existing `SemanticsService.sendAnnouncement` pattern (`vault_lock_screen.dart:68-74`) to the PIN-mismatch transition too.
- `test/features/vault/data/repositories/vault_repository_impl_test.dart` (existing) — add `submitPin` cases from the I/O matrix with a mocked `FlutterSecureStorage`.
- `test/features/vault/presentation/widgets/pin_keypad_test.dart` (new) — digit entry, backspace, 350ms auto-advance, no overflow at largest `TextScaler`.
- `test/features/vault/presentation/screens/vault_lock_screen_test.dart` (existing) — replace the obsolete retry-button cases with: biometric-fail → keypad+error band; "Usar PIN" reachable pre-failure; correct/incorrect PIN outcomes.
- `test/core/navigation/app_router_test.dart:59-91`, `test/main_test.dart:64-93` — both `_FakeVaultRepository`s need a `submitPin` override added (interface change).

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [ ] `lib/features/vault/domain/repositories/vault_repository.dart` -- add `submitPin` -- new fallback entry point (RNF09: `Either<Failure, Unit>`).
- [ ] `lib/features/vault/data/repositories/vault_repository_impl.dart` -- implement `submitPin` with `FlutterSecureStorage` -- set-on-first-use/compare per I/O matrix.
- [ ] `lib/features/vault/vault_injection.dart` -- inject `sl<FlutterSecureStorage>()` -- reuses the existing singleton, no new one.
- [ ] `lib/core/design_tokens.dart` -- add PIN keypad component tokens -- RNF08, no value hardcoded elsewhere.
- [ ] `lib/features/vault/presentation/widgets/pin_keypad.dart` -- create keypad widget -- UX-DR14.
- [ ] `lib/features/vault/presentation/screens/vault_lock_screen.dart` -- replace retry button with PIN-mode view + "Usar PIN" link -- AC1/AC2.
- [ ] `test/features/vault/data/repositories/vault_repository_impl_test.dart` -- add `submitPin` coverage.
- [ ] `test/features/vault/presentation/widgets/pin_keypad_test.dart` -- create, cover grid/backspace/auto-advance/Dynamic-Type.
- [ ] `test/features/vault/presentation/screens/vault_lock_screen_test.dart` -- replace retry-button cases with PIN-flow cases.
- [ ] `test/core/navigation/app_router_test.dart`, `test/main_test.dart` -- add `submitPin` override to both fakes.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given Face ID/Touch ID fails to recognize me, when the failure is reported, then "Não foi possível reconhecer — digite seu PIN" appears with the PIN keypad always reachable — never a dead end.
- Given repeated biometric failures trigger an OS-level lockout, when that lockout is detected, then the app shows the PIN keypad rather than offering any biometric-retry affordance.
- Given the PIN keypad, when I enter the 4th digit, then the app auto-advances 350ms later with no explicit confirm tap, the transition is announced to screen readers, and the digits stay legible at the largest Dynamic Type size.

## Design Notes

No PIN-creation screen exists in `docs/input/` or the prototype (only "PIN inicial"/"PIN após falha", both entry screens) — set-on-first-use is this spec's own resolution, not a product decision made elsewhere. `flutter_secure_storage` already encrypts at rest (Keychain) and is in the pinned stack; a hashing layer (`package:crypto`) is not, so the PIN is compared as the plain stored string rather than adding an unpinned dependency.

## Verification

**Commands:**
- `fvm flutter analyze` -- expected: zero issues.
- `fvm flutter test` -- expected: all pass, including new/updated vault and keypad tests.

**Manual checks (if no CLI):**
- No device/simulator exists yet (AGENTS.md) — the real OS biometric-lockout trigger is unverifiable until one does; pre-existing gap, not introduced here.

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** Spec-2-1's `/vault` screen offers only a "Tentar novamente" biometric-retry button — no PIN entry exists, so a biometric decline/cancel/OS-lockout has no real fallback.

**Approach:** Replace the retry button with a real PIN keypad (Tela 0.1b/0.1c): any biometric failure (decline/cancel/`LocalAuthExceptionCode` lockout) falls through to the keypad+error copy; a new "Usar PIN" link reaches it directly. No PIN-creation screen exists anywhere in `docs/input/` (decide-and-proceed): first entry when no PIN is stored becomes the stored PIN; later entries verify against it.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:** Every `authenticate()` failure (any code/lockout/`false`) shows the PIN keypad — never a second OS-retry affordance (AC2). `submitPin` success emits `VaultStatus.unlocked`, same as biometric; no new enum value. PIN compared as plain strings in `flutter_secure_storage` (Keychain-encrypted already; no new hash dependency — not pinned). PIN has no attempt cap — always retryable. Keypad: structural palette only, 4 dots, 350ms auto-advance, ≥44pt targets, no Dynamic-Type truncation (UX-DR14/21/22).

**Ask First:** None.

**Never:** No PIN-confirmation re-entry. No storage outside `flutter_secure_storage`. Don't reintroduce "Tentar novamente". Out of scope: 2.3 idle timeout, 2.4 preference persistence.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Biometric fails (decline/cancel/any `LocalAuthException`, incl. lockout) | `authenticate()` returns `Left` | Screen shows PIN keypad + "Não foi possível reconhecer — digite seu PIN"; screen-reader announces the transition | N/A |
| User taps "Usar PIN" from the biometric view | tap, no prior failure | PIN keypad shown, no error band | N/A |
| `submitPin`, no PIN stored yet | 4 digits entered | Stored as the new PIN, `unlocked`, `Right(unit)` | N/A |
| `submitPin`, stored PIN matches | 4 digits entered | `unlocked`, `Right(unit)` | N/A |
| `submitPin`, stored PIN mismatch | 4 digits entered | Stays `locked`, keypad clears for another attempt — never a dead end | `Left(Failure.malformedResponse(...))` |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `lib/features/vault/domain/repositories/vault_repository.dart` — add `Future<Either<Failure, Unit>> submitPin(String pin)` to the contract.
- `lib/features/vault/data/repositories/vault_repository_impl.dart:25-29,96` — add `FlutterSecureStorage` ctor param (mirrors `LocalAuthentication`); implement `submitPin` (key `'vault_pin'`, `read`/`write`, set-on-first-use/compare semantics from the I/O matrix); existing `authenticate()` catch blocks are already generic enough — no lockout-code special-casing needed (resolves spec-2-1's deferred finding since every failure now falls to the same PIN path).
- `lib/features/vault/vault_injection.dart:11-24` — pass `sl<FlutterSecureStorage>()` (already registered in `injection_container.dart:31-33` for auth) into `VaultRepositoryImpl`.
- `lib/features/auth/data/datasources/secure_storage_access_token_provider.dart` — exact `_storage.read(key:)`/`.write(key:,value:)` pattern to mirror.
- `lib/core/design_tokens.dart` — add PIN-keypad-only constants (digit button size, dot size/gap) under a new documented section; prototype-extract.md §3/§6 names the component but not its exact px.
- `lib/features/vault/presentation/widgets/pin_keypad.dart` (new) — self-contained 3×4 grid + backspace + 4 progress dots; owns its own digit buffer; clears and calls `onSubmit(pin)` 350ms after the 4th digit (prototype-extract.md §3).
- `lib/features/vault/presentation/screens/vault_lock_screen.dart` — remove the "Tentar novamente" `AppButton`; add "Usar PIN" ghost link (`AppButtonVariant.textGhost`, mirrors `auth_screen.dart`'s toggle link); add PIN-mode view (`PinKeypad` + conditional error band); wire `submitPin`; extend the existing `SemanticsService.sendAnnouncement` pattern (`vault_lock_screen.dart:68-74`) to the PIN-mismatch transition too.
- `test/features/vault/data/repositories/vault_repository_impl_test.dart` (existing) — add `submitPin` cases from the I/O matrix with a mocked `FlutterSecureStorage`.
- `test/features/vault/presentation/widgets/pin_keypad_test.dart` (new) — digit entry, backspace, 350ms auto-advance, no overflow at largest `TextScaler`.
- `test/features/vault/presentation/screens/vault_lock_screen_test.dart` (existing) — replace the obsolete retry-button cases with: biometric-fail → keypad+error band; "Usar PIN" reachable pre-failure; correct/incorrect PIN outcomes.
- `test/core/navigation/app_router_test.dart:59-91`, `test/main_test.dart:64-93` — both `_FakeVaultRepository`s need a `submitPin` override added (interface change).

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [ ] `lib/features/vault/domain/repositories/vault_repository.dart` -- add `submitPin` -- new fallback entry point (RNF09: `Either<Failure, Unit>`).
- [ ] `lib/features/vault/data/repositories/vault_repository_impl.dart` -- implement `submitPin` with `FlutterSecureStorage` -- set-on-first-use/compare per I/O matrix.
- [ ] `lib/features/vault/vault_injection.dart` -- inject `sl<FlutterSecureStorage>()` -- reuses the existing singleton, no new one.
- [ ] `lib/core/design_tokens.dart` -- add PIN keypad component tokens -- RNF08, no value hardcoded elsewhere.
- [ ] `lib/features/vault/presentation/widgets/pin_keypad.dart` -- create keypad widget -- UX-DR14.
- [ ] `lib/features/vault/presentation/screens/vault_lock_screen.dart` -- replace retry button with PIN-mode view + "Usar PIN" link -- AC1/AC2.
- [ ] `test/features/vault/data/repositories/vault_repository_impl_test.dart` -- add `submitPin` coverage.
- [ ] `test/features/vault/presentation/widgets/pin_keypad_test.dart` -- create, cover grid/backspace/auto-advance/Dynamic-Type.
- [ ] `test/features/vault/presentation/screens/vault_lock_screen_test.dart` -- replace retry-button cases with PIN-flow cases.
- [ ] `test/core/navigation/app_router_test.dart`, `test/main_test.dart` -- add `submitPin` override to both fakes.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given Face ID/Touch ID fails to recognize me, when the failure is reported, then "Não foi possível reconhecer — digite seu PIN" appears with the PIN keypad always reachable — never a dead end.
- Given repeated biometric failures trigger an OS-level lockout, when that lockout is detected, then the app shows the PIN keypad rather than offering any biometric-retry affordance.
- Given the PIN keypad, when I enter the 4th digit, then the app auto-advances 350ms later with no explicit confirm tap, the transition is announced to screen readers, and the digits stay legible at the largest Dynamic Type size.

## Design Notes

No PIN-creation screen exists in `docs/input/` or the prototype (only "PIN inicial"/"PIN após falha", both entry screens) — set-on-first-use is this spec's own resolution, not a product decision made elsewhere. `flutter_secure_storage` already encrypts at rest (Keychain) and is in the pinned stack; a hashing layer (`package:crypto`) is not, so the PIN is compared as the plain stored string rather than adding an unpinned dependency.

## Verification

**Commands:**

- `fvm flutter test` -- expected: all pass, including new/updated vault and keypad tests.

**Manual checks (if no CLI):**
