title: 'Biometric-Failure Fallback to PIN'
type: 'feature'
created: '2026-11-03'
status: 'draft'
review_loop_iteration: 0
context: []
---

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** Spec-2-1's `/vault` screen offers only a "Tentar novamente" biometric-retry button — no PIN entry exists, so a biometric decline/cancel/OS-lockout has no real fallback.

**Approach:** Replace the retry button with a real PIN keypad (Tela 0.1b/0.1c): any biometric failure (decline/cancel/`LocalAuthExceptionCode` lockout) falls through to the keypad+error copy; a new "Usar PIN" link reaches it directly. No PIN-creation screen exists anywhere in `docs/input/` (decide-and-proceed): first entry when no PIN is stored becomes the stored PIN; later entries verify against it.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:** Every `authenticate()` failure (any code/lockout/`false`) shows the PIN keypad — never a second OS-retry affordance (AC2). `submitPin` success emits `VaultStatus.unlocked`, same as biometric; no new enum value. PIN compared as plain strings in `flutter_secure_storage` (Keychain-encrypted already; no new hash dependency — not pinned). PIN has no attempt cap — always retryable. Keypad: structural palette only, 4 dots, 350ms auto-advance, ≥44pt targets, no Dynamic-Type truncation (UX-DR14/21/22).

**Ask First:** None.

**Never:** No PIN-confirmation re-entry. No storage outside `flutter_secure_storage`. Don't reintroduce "Tentar novamente". Out of scope: 2.3 idle timeout, 2.4 preference persistence.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Biometric fails (decline/cancel/any `LocalAuthException`, incl. lockout) | `authenticate()` returns `Left` | Screen shows PIN keypad + "Não foi possível reconhecer — digite seu PIN"; screen-reader announces the transition | N/A |
| User taps "Usar PIN" from the biometric view | tap, no prior failure | PIN keypad shown, no error band | N/A |
| `submitPin`, no PIN stored yet | 4 digits entered | Stored as the new PIN, `unlocked`, `Right(unit)` | N/A |
| `submitPin`, stored PIN matches | 4 digits entered | `unlocked`, `Right(unit)` | N/A |
| `submitPin`, stored PIN mismatch | 4 digits entered | Stays `locked`, keypad clears for another attempt — never a dead end | `Left(Failure.malformedResponse(...))` |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `lib/features/vault/domain/repositories/vault_repository.dart` — add `Future<Either<Failure, Unit>> submitPin(String pin)`.
- `lib/features/vault/data/repositories/vault_repository_impl.dart:25-29,96` — add `FlutterSecureStorage` ctor param (mirrors `LocalAuthentication`); implement `submitPin` (key `'vault_pin'`, set-on-first-use/compare). Existing `authenticate()` catches already cover lockout generically — resolves spec-2-1's deferred finding since every failure now routes to the same PIN path, no code-specific branch needed.
- `lib/features/vault/vault_injection.dart:11-24` — pass `sl<FlutterSecureStorage>()` (already registered `injection_container.dart:31-33`) into `VaultRepositoryImpl`.
- `lib/features/auth/data/datasources/secure_storage_access_token_provider.dart` — `_storage.read(key:)`/`.write(key:,value:)` pattern to mirror.
- `lib/core/design_tokens.dart` — add PIN-keypad-only size constants (prototype-extract.md §3/§6 names the component, not its px).
- `lib/features/vault/presentation/widgets/pin_keypad.dart` (new) — 3×4 grid + backspace + 4 dots; owns its digit buffer; clears and calls `onSubmit(pin)` 350ms after the 4th digit.
- `lib/features/vault/presentation/screens/vault_lock_screen.dart` — drop the "Tentar novamente" `AppButton`; add "Usar PIN" ghost link (`AppButtonVariant.textGhost`, mirrors `auth_screen.dart`'s toggle link); add PIN-mode view (`PinKeypad` + conditional error band); wire `submitPin`; extend the existing `SemanticsService.sendAnnouncement` (`:68-74`) to PIN mismatch too.
- `test/features/vault/data/repositories/vault_repository_impl_test.dart` — add `submitPin` cases, mocked `FlutterSecureStorage`.
- `test/features/vault/presentation/widgets/pin_keypad_test.dart` (new) — entry/backspace/auto-advance/no-overflow at largest `TextScaler`.
- `test/features/vault/presentation/screens/vault_lock_screen_test.dart` — swap obsolete retry-button cases for: fail→keypad+error; "Usar PIN" reachable pre-failure; correct/incorrect PIN.
- `test/core/navigation/app_router_test.dart:59-91`, `test/main_test.dart:64-93` — add `submitPin` override to both `_FakeVaultRepository`s.

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [ ] `vault_repository.dart` -- add `submitPin` -- RNF09 `Either<Failure, Unit>`.
- [ ] `vault_repository_impl.dart` -- implement `submitPin` via `FlutterSecureStorage` -- per I/O matrix.
- [ ] `vault_injection.dart` -- inject `sl<FlutterSecureStorage>()` -- reuses existing singleton.
- [ ] `design_tokens.dart` -- add PIN keypad tokens -- RNF08.
- [ ] `pin_keypad.dart` -- create keypad widget -- UX-DR14.
- [ ] `vault_lock_screen.dart` -- swap retry button for PIN-mode view + "Usar PIN" -- AC1/AC2.
- [ ] `vault_repository_impl_test.dart` -- add `submitPin` coverage.
- [ ] `pin_keypad_test.dart` -- create; cover grid/backspace/auto-advance/Dynamic-Type.
- [ ] `vault_lock_screen_test.dart` -- replace retry-button cases with PIN-flow cases.
- [ ] `app_router_test.dart`, `main_test.dart` -- add `submitPin` override to both fakes.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given Face ID/Touch ID fails to recognize me, when the failure is reported, then "Não foi possível reconhecer — digite seu PIN" appears with the PIN keypad always reachable — never a dead end.
- Given repeated biometric failures trigger an OS-level lockout, when that lockout is detected, then the app shows the PIN keypad rather than offering any biometric-retry affordance.
- Given the PIN keypad, when I enter the 4th digit, then the app auto-advances 350ms later with no explicit confirm tap, the transition is announced to screen readers, and the digits stay legible at the largest Dynamic Type size.

## Design Notes

No PIN-creation screen exists anywhere ("PIN inicial"/"PIN após falha" are both entry screens) — set-on-first-use is this spec's own resolution. `flutter_secure_storage` already encrypts at rest and is pinned; `package:crypto` is not, so the PIN is compared as the plain stored string rather than adding a dependency.

## Verification

**Commands:**
- `fvm flutter analyze` -- expected: zero issues.
- `fvm flutter test` -- expected: all pass, including new/updated vault and keypad tests.

**Manual checks (if no CLI):**
- No device/simulator exists yet (AGENTS.md) — the real OS biometric-lockout trigger is unverifiable until one does; pre-existing gap, not introduced here.

title: 'Biometric-Failure Fallback to PIN'
type: 'feature'
created: '2026-11-03'
status: 'ready-for-dev'
review_loop_iteration: 0
context: []
---

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** Spec-2-1's `/vault` screen offers only a "Tentar novamente" biometric-retry button — no PIN entry exists, so a biometric decline/cancel/OS-lockout has no real fallback.

**Approach:** Replace the retry button with a real PIN keypad (Tela 0.1b/0.1c): any biometric failure (decline/cancel/`LocalAuthExceptionCode` lockout) falls through to the keypad+error copy; a new "Usar PIN" link reaches it directly. No PIN-creation screen exists anywhere in `docs/input/` (decide-and-proceed): first entry when no PIN is stored becomes the stored PIN; later entries verify against it.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:** Every `authenticate()` failure (any code/lockout/`false`) shows the PIN keypad — never a second OS-retry affordance (AC2). `submitPin` success emits `VaultStatus.unlocked`, same as biometric; no new enum value. PIN compared as plain strings in `flutter_secure_storage` (Keychain-encrypted already; no new hash dependency — not pinned). PIN has no attempt cap — always retryable. Keypad: structural palette only, 4 dots, 350ms auto-advance, ≥44pt targets, no Dynamic-Type truncation (UX-DR14/21/22).

**Ask First:** None.

**Never:** No PIN-confirmation re-entry. No storage outside `flutter_secure_storage`. Don't reintroduce "Tentar novamente". Out of scope: 2.3 idle timeout, 2.4 preference persistence.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Biometric fails (decline/cancel/any `LocalAuthException`, incl. lockout) | `authenticate()` returns `Left` | Screen shows PIN keypad + "Não foi possível reconhecer — digite seu PIN"; screen-reader announces the transition | N/A |
| User taps "Usar PIN" from the biometric view | tap, no prior failure | PIN keypad shown, no error band | N/A |
| `submitPin`, no PIN stored yet | 4 digits entered | Stored as the new PIN, `unlocked`, `Right(unit)` | N/A |
| `submitPin`, stored PIN matches | 4 digits entered | `unlocked`, `Right(unit)` | N/A |
| `submitPin`, stored PIN mismatch | 4 digits entered | Stays `locked`, keypad clears for another attempt — never a dead end | `Left(Failure.malformedResponse(...))` |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `lib/features/vault/domain/repositories/vault_repository.dart` — add `Future<Either<Failure, Unit>> submitPin(String pin)`.
- `lib/features/vault/data/repositories/vault_repository_impl.dart:25-29,96` — add `FlutterSecureStorage` ctor param (mirrors `LocalAuthentication`); implement `submitPin` (key `'vault_pin'`, set-on-first-use/compare). Existing `authenticate()` catches already cover lockout generically — resolves spec-2-1's deferred finding since every failure now routes to the same PIN path, no code-specific branch needed.
- `lib/features/vault/vault_injection.dart:11-24` — pass `sl<FlutterSecureStorage>()` (already registered `injection_container.dart:31-33`) into `VaultRepositoryImpl`.
- `lib/features/auth/data/datasources/secure_storage_access_token_provider.dart` — `_storage.read(key:)`/`.write(key:,value:)` pattern to mirror.
- `lib/core/design_tokens.dart` — add PIN-keypad-only size constants (prototype-extract.md §3/§6 names the component, not its px).
- `lib/features/vault/presentation/widgets/pin_keypad.dart` (new) — 3×4 grid + backspace + 4 dots; owns its digit buffer; clears and calls `onSubmit(pin)` 350ms after the 4th digit.
- `lib/features/vault/presentation/screens/vault_lock_screen.dart` — drop the "Tentar novamente" `AppButton`; add "Usar PIN" ghost link (`AppButtonVariant.textGhost`, mirrors `auth_screen.dart`'s toggle link); add PIN-mode view (`PinKeypad` + conditional error band); wire `submitPin`; extend the existing `SemanticsService.sendAnnouncement` (`:68-74`) to PIN mismatch too.
- `test/features/vault/data/repositories/vault_repository_impl_test.dart` — add `submitPin` cases, mocked `FlutterSecureStorage`.
- `test/features/vault/presentation/widgets/pin_keypad_test.dart` (new) — entry/backspace/auto-advance/no-overflow at largest `TextScaler`.
- `test/features/vault/presentation/screens/vault_lock_screen_test.dart` — swap obsolete retry-button cases for: fail→keypad+error; "Usar PIN" reachable pre-failure; correct/incorrect PIN.
- `test/core/navigation/app_router_test.dart:59-91`, `test/main_test.dart:64-93` — add `submitPin` override to both `_FakeVaultRepository`s.

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [ ] `vault_repository.dart` -- add `submitPin` -- RNF09 `Either<Failure, Unit>`.
- [ ] `vault_repository_impl.dart` -- implement `submitPin` via `FlutterSecureStorage` -- per I/O matrix.
- [ ] `vault_injection.dart` -- inject `sl<FlutterSecureStorage>()` -- reuses existing singleton.
- [ ] `design_tokens.dart` -- add PIN keypad tokens -- RNF08.
- [ ] `pin_keypad.dart` -- create keypad widget -- UX-DR14.
- [ ] `vault_lock_screen.dart` -- swap retry button for PIN-mode view + "Usar PIN" -- AC1/AC2.
- [ ] `vault_repository_impl_test.dart` -- add `submitPin` coverage.
- [ ] `pin_keypad_test.dart` -- create; cover grid/backspace/auto-advance/Dynamic-Type.
- [ ] `vault_lock_screen_test.dart` -- replace retry-button cases with PIN-flow cases.
- [ ] `app_router_test.dart`, `main_test.dart` -- add `submitPin` override to both fakes.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given Face ID/Touch ID fails to recognize me, when the failure is reported, then "Não foi possível reconhecer — digite seu PIN" appears with the PIN keypad always reachable — never a dead end.
- Given repeated biometric failures trigger an OS-level lockout, when that lockout is detected, then the app shows the PIN keypad rather than offering any biometric-retry affordance.
- Given the PIN keypad, when I enter the 4th digit, then the app auto-advances 350ms later with no explicit confirm tap, the transition is announced to screen readers, and the digits stay legible at the largest Dynamic Type size.

## Design Notes

No PIN-creation screen exists anywhere ("PIN inicial"/"PIN após falha" are both entry screens) — set-on-first-use is this spec's own resolution. `flutter_secure_storage` already encrypts at rest and is pinned; `package:crypto` is not, so the PIN is compared as the plain stored string rather than adding a dependency.

**Commands:**
- `fvm flutter analyze` -- expected: zero issues.
- `fvm flutter test` -- expected: all pass, including new/updated vault and keypad tests.

**Manual checks (if no CLI):**
- No device/simulator exists yet (AGENTS.md) — the real OS biometric-lockout trigger is unverifiable until one does; pre-existing gap, not introduced here.

2. Find the `development_status` entry matching `{story_key}`. If not found, warn the user once (`"{story_key} not found in sprint-status; skipping sprint sync"`) and return to caller.

4. Set `development_status[{story_key}]` to `{target_status}`.
5. **Epic lift (only when `target_status` = `in-progress`).** Derive the parent epic key as `epic-{N}` from the leading numeric segment of `{story_key}` (e.g., `3-2-digest-delivery` → `epic-3`). 7. Save the file, preserving ALL comments and structure including STATUS DEFINITIONS and WORKFLOW NOTES.

6	/// The epic's ONE new DI-singleton access point for device-level access
7	/// (AD-14) — `core/navigation/app_router.dart`'s `_redirect` reads
8	/// [currentStatus] before it reads `SessionRepository.currentStatus`
9	/// (Boundaries: "`_redirect` checks `VaultStatus` before `SessionStatus`").
10	/// Mirrors `features/auth/domain/repositories/session_repository.dart`'s
11	/// shape, except [currentStatus] is never nullable (see [VaultStatus]'s own
12	/// doc) and there is no `restoreSession`-equivalent boot call — the vault
13	/// is always [VaultStatus.locked] until a successful [authenticate] call.
14	abstract class VaultRepository {
15	  /// Broadcast stream of the current vault status. Unlike
16	  /// `SessionRepository.statusStream`, this always has a value from the
17	  /// moment the repository is constructed ([VaultStatus.locked]) — a late
18	  /// subscriber still immediately replays that cached value, same
19	  /// `Stream.multi` rationale as the session repository's own stream.
20	  Stream<VaultStatus> get statusStream;
21	
22	  /// The last status emitted on [statusStream], read synchronously —
23	  /// starts at [VaultStatus.locked] (never `null`, see [VaultStatus]'s own
24	  /// doc) and only a successful [authenticate] call ever flips it to
25	  /// [VaultStatus.unlocked].
26	  VaultStatus get currentStatus;
27	
28	  /// Triggers the OS biometric prompt (`local_auth`, `biometricOnly: true`
29	  /// — Boundaries: "never set `biometricOnly: false`"). Zero network calls
30	  /// (Boundaries: "Vault makes zero network calls"); never produces
31	  /// [Failure.authInvalid] (reserved for password login) — any failure here
32	  /// (OS declines, cancels, or throws `LocalAuthException`) maps to
33	  /// [Failure.malformedResponse] instead, and [currentStatus] stays
34	  /// [VaultStatus.locked]. Only a `true` result flips [currentStatus] to
35	  /// [VaultStatus.unlocked] and emits it on [statusStream].
36	  Future<Either<Failure, Unit>> authenticate();
37	
38	  /// Story 2.2's biometric-failure fallback. No PIN-creation screen exists
39	  /// anywhere in `docs/input/` (Design Notes): the first call ever made to
40	  /// this method — regardless of which screen reached the keypad — stores
41	  /// [pin] as the vault's PIN and immediately succeeds; every later call
42	  /// compares [pin] against that stored value. A match (first-use or
43	  /// later) flips [currentStatus] to [VaultStatus.unlocked] and emits it on
44	  /// [statusStream], same as a successful [authenticate]. A mismatch never
45	  /// throws, never caps retries, and leaves [currentStatus] at
46	  /// [VaultStatus.locked] — [Failure.malformedResponse] is returned instead
47	  /// (RNF09), so the caller always has a retryable path, never a dead end.
48	  Future<Either<Failure, Unit>> submitPin(String pin);
49	
50	  /// Releases the underlying stream resource. Wired as `get_it`'s
51	  /// `dispose:` callback on registration, so `resetCoreDependencies()`
52	  /// (`sl.reset()`) closes it instead of leaking a `StreamController` on
53	  /// every test teardown.
54	  Future<void> dispose();
55	}

title: 'Biometric-Failure Fallback to PIN'
type: 'feature'
created: '2026-11-03'
status: 'in-progress'
review_loop_iteration: 0

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** Spec-2-1's `/vault` screen offers only a "Tentar novamente" biometric-retry button — no PIN entry exists, so a biometric decline/cancel/OS-lockout has no real fallback.

**Approach:** Replace the retry button with a real PIN keypad (Tela 0.1b/0.1c): any biometric failure (decline/cancel/`LocalAuthExceptionCode` lockout) falls through to the keypad+error copy; a new "Usar PIN" link reaches it directly. No PIN-creation screen exists anywhere in `docs/input/` (decide-and-proceed): first entry when no PIN is stored becomes the stored PIN; later entries verify against it.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:** Every `authenticate()` failure (any code/lockout/`false`) shows the PIN keypad — never a second OS-retry affordance (AC2). `submitPin` success emits `VaultStatus.unlocked`, same as biometric; no new enum value. PIN compared as plain strings in `flutter_secure_storage` (Keychain-encrypted already; no new hash dependency — not pinned). PIN has no attempt cap — always retryable. Keypad: structural palette only, 4 dots, 350ms auto-advance, ≥44pt targets, no Dynamic-Type truncation (UX-DR14/21/22).

**Ask First:** None.

**Never:** No PIN-confirmation re-entry. No storage outside `flutter_secure_storage`. Don't reintroduce "Tentar novamente". Out of scope: 2.3 idle timeout, 2.4 preference persistence.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Biometric fails (decline/cancel/any `LocalAuthException`, incl. lockout) | `authenticate()` returns `Left` | Screen shows PIN keypad + "Não foi possível reconhecer — digite seu PIN"; screen-reader announces the transition | N/A |
| User taps "Usar PIN" from the biometric view | tap, no prior failure | PIN keypad shown, no error band | N/A |
| `submitPin`, no PIN stored yet | 4 digits entered | Stored as the new PIN, `unlocked`, `Right(unit)` | N/A |
| `submitPin`, stored PIN matches | 4 digits entered | `unlocked`, `Right(unit)` | N/A |
| `submitPin`, stored PIN mismatch | 4 digits entered | Stays `locked`, keypad clears for another attempt — never a dead end | `Left(Failure.malformedResponse(...))` |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `lib/features/vault/domain/repositories/vault_repository.dart` — add `Future<Either<Failure, Unit>> submitPin(String pin)`.
- `lib/features/vault/data/repositories/vault_repository_impl.dart:25-29,96` — add `FlutterSecureStorage` ctor param (mirrors `LocalAuthentication`); implement `submitPin` (key `'vault_pin'`, set-on-first-use/compare). Existing `authenticate()` catches already cover lockout generically — resolves spec-2-1's deferred finding since every failure now routes to the same PIN path, no code-specific branch needed.
- `lib/features/vault/vault_injection.dart:11-24` — pass `sl<FlutterSecureStorage>()` (already registered `injection_container.dart:31-33`) into `VaultRepositoryImpl`.
- `lib/features/auth/data/datasources/secure_storage_access_token_provider.dart` — `_storage.read(key:)`/`.write(key:,value:)` pattern to mirror.
- `lib/core/design_tokens.dart` — add PIN-keypad-only size constants (prototype-extract.md §3/§6 names the component, not its px).
- `lib/features/vault/presentation/widgets/pin_keypad.dart` (new) — 3×4 grid + backspace + 4 dots; owns its digit buffer; clears and calls `onSubmit(pin)` 350ms after the 4th digit.
- `lib/features/vault/presentation/screens/vault_lock_screen.dart` — drop the "Tentar novamente" `AppButton`; add "Usar PIN" ghost link (`AppButtonVariant.textGhost`, mirrors `auth_screen.dart`'s toggle link); add PIN-mode view (`PinKeypad` + conditional error band); wire `submitPin`; extend the existing `SemanticsService.sendAnnouncement` (`:68-74`) to PIN mismatch too.
- `test/features/vault/data/repositories/vault_repository_impl_test.dart` — add `submitPin` cases, mocked `FlutterSecureStorage`.
- `test/features/vault/presentation/widgets/pin_keypad_test.dart` (new) — entry/backspace/auto-advance/no-overflow at largest `TextScaler`.
- `test/features/vault/presentation/screens/vault_lock_screen_test.dart` — swap obsolete retry-button cases for: fail→keypad+error; "Usar PIN" reachable pre-failure; correct/incorrect PIN.
- `test/core/navigation/app_router_test.dart:59-91`, `test/main_test.dart:64-93` — add `submitPin` override to both `_FakeVaultRepository`s.

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [ ] `vault_repository.dart` -- add `submitPin` -- RNF09 `Either<Failure, Unit>`.
- [ ] `vault_repository_impl.dart` -- implement `submitPin` via `FlutterSecureStorage` -- per I/O matrix.
- [ ] `vault_injection.dart` -- inject `sl<FlutterSecureStorage>()` -- reuses existing singleton.
- [ ] `design_tokens.dart` -- add PIN keypad tokens -- RNF08.
- [ ] `pin_keypad.dart` -- create keypad widget -- UX-DR14.
- [ ] `vault_lock_screen.dart` -- swap retry button for PIN-mode view + "Usar PIN" -- AC1/AC2.
- [ ] `vault_repository_impl_test.dart` -- add `submitPin` coverage.
- [ ] `pin_keypad_test.dart` -- create; cover grid/backspace/auto-advance/Dynamic-Type.
- [ ] `vault_lock_screen_test.dart` -- replace retry-button cases with PIN-flow cases.
- [ ] `app_router_test.dart`, `main_test.dart` -- add `submitPin` override to both fakes.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given Face ID/Touch ID fails to recognize me, when the failure is reported, then "Não foi possível reconhecer — digite seu PIN" appears with the PIN keypad always reachable — never a dead end.
- Given repeated biometric failures trigger an OS-level lockout, when that lockout is detected, then the app shows the PIN keypad rather than offering any biometric-retry affordance.
- Given the PIN keypad, when I enter the 4th digit, then the app auto-advances 350ms later with no explicit confirm tap, the transition is announced to screen readers, and the digits stay legible at the largest Dynamic Type size.

## Design Notes

No PIN-creation screen exists anywhere ("PIN inicial"/"PIN após falha" are both entry screens) — set-on-first-use is this spec's own resolution. `flutter_secure_storage` already encrypts at rest and is pinned; `package:crypto` is not, so the PIN is compared as the plain stored string rather than adding a dependency.

## Verification

**Commands:**
- `fvm flutter analyze` -- expected: zero issues.
- `fvm flutter test` -- expected: all pass, including new/updated vault and keypad tests.

**Manual checks (if no CLI):**
- No device/simulator exists yet (AGENTS.md) — the real OS biometric-lockout trigger is unverifiable until one does; pre-existing gap, not introduced here.

# Step 4: Review

## RULES

- **Language** — Speak in `English`. Write any file output in `English`.
- All review subagents must run at the same model capability as the current session.
- Run subagents synchronously: launch them together, then wait for all results before continuing.

Do NOT `git add` anything — this is read-only inspection.

### Review

Execute these review layers in parallel wherever their execution methods allow: substitute the runtime placeholders (e.g. `{diff_output}`) into each layer's instruction. When an instruction launches a reviewer subagent, launch that child with the prompt text after placeholder substitution; do not load the reviewer instruction file yourself. For any other customized instruction, execute it as written. Parallel means several blocking calls awaited together in this turn — never backgrounded or detached, never ending the turn to await results. When running layers as subagents, spawn every reviewer before reading or reacting to any of their output; begin collection and triage only once all are launched.

#### Blind Hunter (`blind-hunter`)

Launch a context-free subagent with this prompt:

Conduct a review of CONTENT.
Look for what's missing, not only what's wrong.
Find at least ten issues to fix or improve.

If the content is empty, stop and say so.

{diff_output}

---
title: 'Biometric-Failure Fallback to PIN'
type: 'feature'
created: '2026-11-03'
status: 'in-progress'
review_loop_iteration: 0
context: []
baseline_commit: '815e7cc4fb8633554f0483eb0c31ad81f35d1f97'
---

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** Spec-2-1's `/vault` screen offers only a "Tentar novamente" biometric-retry button — no PIN entry exists, so a biometric decline/cancel/OS-lockout has no real fallback.

**Approach:** Replace the retry button with a real PIN keypad (Tela 0.1b/0.1c): any biometric failure (decline/cancel/`LocalAuthExceptionCode` lockout) falls through to the keypad+error copy; a new "Usar PIN" link reaches it directly. No PIN-creation screen exists anywhere in `docs/input/` (decide-and-proceed): first entry when no PIN is stored becomes the stored PIN; later entries verify against it.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:** Every `authenticate()` failure (any code/lockout/`false`) shows the PIN keypad — never a second OS-retry affordance (AC2). `submitPin` success emits `VaultStatus.unlocked`, same as biometric; no new enum value. PIN compared as plain strings in `flutter_secure_storage` (Keychain-encrypted already; no new hash dependency — not pinned). PIN has no attempt cap — always retryable. Keypad: structural palette only, 4 dots, 350ms auto-advance, ≥44pt targets, no Dynamic-Type truncation (UX-DR14/21/22).

**Ask First:** None.

**Never:** No PIN-confirmation re-entry. No storage outside `flutter_secure_storage`. Don't reintroduce "Tentar novamente". Out of scope: 2.3 idle timeout, 2.4 preference persistence.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Biometric fails (decline/cancel/any `LocalAuthException`, incl. lockout) | `authenticate()` returns `Left` | Screen shows PIN keypad + "Não foi possível reconhecer — digite seu PIN"; screen-reader announces the transition | N/A |
| User taps "Usar PIN" from the biometric view | tap, no prior failure | PIN keypad shown, no error band | N/A |
| `submitPin`, no PIN stored yet | 4 digits entered | Stored as the new PIN, `unlocked`, `Right(unit)` | N/A |
| `submitPin`, stored PIN matches | 4 digits entered | `unlocked`, `Right(unit)` | N/A |
| `submitPin`, stored PIN mismatch | 4 digits entered | Stays `locked`, keypad clears for another attempt — never a dead end | `Left(Failure.malformedResponse(...))` |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `lib/features/vault/domain/repositories/vault_repository.dart` — add `Future<Either<Failure, Unit>> submitPin(String pin)`.
- `lib/features/vault/data/repositories/vault_repository_impl.dart:25-29,96` — add `FlutterSecureStorage` ctor param (mirrors `LocalAuthentication`); implement `submitPin` (key `'vault_pin'`, set-on-first-use/compare). Existing `authenticate()` catches already cover lockout generically — resolves spec-2-1's deferred finding since every failure now routes to the same PIN path, no code-specific branch needed.
- `lib/features/vault/vault_injection.dart:11-24` — pass `sl<FlutterSecureStorage>()` (already registered `injection_container.dart:31-33`) into `VaultRepositoryImpl`.
- `lib/features/auth/data/datasources/secure_storage_access_token_provider.dart` — `_storage.read(key:)`/`.write(key:,value:)` pattern to mirror.
- `lib/core/design_tokens.dart` — add PIN-keypad-only size constants (prototype-extract.md §3/§6 names the component, not its px).
- `lib/features/vault/presentation/widgets/pin_keypad.dart` (new) — 3×4 grid + backspace + 4 dots; owns its digit buffer; clears and calls `onSubmit(pin)` 350ms after the 4th digit.
- `lib/features/vault/presentation/screens/vault_lock_screen.dart` — drop the "Tentar novamente" `AppButton`; add "Usar PIN" ghost link (`AppButtonVariant.textGhost`, mirrors `auth_screen.dart`'s toggle link); add PIN-mode view (`PinKeypad` + conditional error band); wire `submitPin`; extend the existing `SemanticsService.sendAnnouncement` (`:68-74`) to PIN mismatch too.
- `test/features/vault/data/repositories/vault_repository_impl_test.dart` — add `submitPin` cases, mocked `FlutterSecureStorage`.
- `test/features/vault/presentation/widgets/pin_keypad_test.dart` (new) — entry/backspace/auto-advance/no-overflow at largest `TextScaler`.
- `test/features/vault/presentation/screens/vault_lock_screen_test.dart` — swap obsolete retry-button cases for: fail→keypad+error; "Usar PIN" reachable pre-failure; correct/incorrect PIN.
- `test/core/navigation/app_router_test.dart:59-91`, `test/main_test.dart:64-93` — add `submitPin` override to both `_FakeVaultRepository`s.

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [x] `vault_repository.dart` -- add `submitPin` -- RNF09 `Either<Failure, Unit>`.
- [x] `vault_repository_impl.dart` -- implement `submitPin` via `FlutterSecureStorage` -- per I/O matrix.
- [x] `vault_injection.dart` -- inject `sl<FlutterSecureStorage>()` -- reuses existing singleton.
- [x] `design_tokens.dart` -- add PIN keypad tokens -- RNF08.
- [x] `pin_keypad.dart` -- create keypad widget -- UX-DR14.
- [x] `vault_lock_screen.dart` -- swap retry button for PIN-mode view + "Usar PIN" -- AC1/AC2.
- [x] `vault_repository_impl_test.dart` -- add `submitPin` coverage.
- [x] `pin_keypad_test.dart` -- create; cover grid/backspace/auto-advance/Dynamic-Type.
- [x] `vault_lock_screen_test.dart` -- replace retry-button cases with PIN-flow cases.
- [x] `app_router_test.dart`, `main_test.dart` -- add `submitPin` override to both fakes.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given Face ID/Touch ID fails to recognize me, when the failure is reported, then "Não foi possível reconhecer — digite seu PIN" appears with the PIN keypad always reachable — never a dead end.
- Given repeated biometric failures trigger an OS-level lockout, when that lockout is detected, then the app shows the PIN keypad rather than offering any biometric-retry affordance.
- Given the PIN keypad, when I enter the 4th digit, then the app auto-advances 350ms later with no explicit confirm tap, the transition is announced to screen readers, and the digits stay legible at the largest Dynamic Type size.

## Design Notes

No PIN-creation screen exists anywhere ("PIN inicial"/"PIN após falha" are both entry screens) — set-on-first-use is this spec's own resolution. `flutter_secure_storage` already encrypts at rest and is pinned; `package:crypto` is not, so the PIN is compared as the plain stored string rather than adding a dependency.

## Verification

**Commands:**
- `fvm flutter analyze` -- expected: zero issues.
- `fvm flutter test` -- expected: all pass, including new/updated vault and keypad tests.

**Manual checks (if no CLI):**
- No device/simulator exists yet (AGENTS.md) — the real OS biometric-lockout trigger is unverifiable until one does; pre-existing gap, not introduced here.

entries.name: SendMessage
entries.description:
# SendMessage

Send a message to another agent.

```json
{"to": "researcher", "summary": "assign task 1", "message": "start on task #1"}
```

| `to` | |
|---|---|
| `"researcher"` | Teammate by name |
| `"main"` | The main conversation (background subagents only) |
| `"worker"` | Any agent from `ListAgents` — subagent, another local Claude session |
| `"worker [3fa9c1]"` | Same, plus its `[ref]` — only when a listing or an error shows one |

Your plain text output is NOT visible to other agents — to communicate, you MUST call this tool. Messages from teammates are delivered automatically; you don't check an inbox. Refer to agents by name — names keep working after an agent completes (a send resumes it from its transcript). Use the raw `agentId` (format `a...-...`) from its spawn result only when the agent has no name, or when a newer agent took the name (latest wins). When relaying, don't quote the original — it's already rendered to the user.

## Cross-session

Use `ListAgents` to discover targets. Every row leads with the agent's `name [ref]` — the name IS the address; there is no separate address syntax.

```json
{"to": "worker", "message": "check if tests pass over there"}
{"to": "worker [3fa9c1]", "message": "you, specifically"}
```

Send the bare name — a name that exactly matches one live agent or session (on this machine, on another machine, or in the cloud) delivers directly. Append the ` [ref]` only when the bare name is not enough — `ListAgents` shows two rows with it, or an error asks you to disambiguate (you typed only a prefix, or a session list could not be checked). A ref you did not just read from a listing or an error will not resolve, and if the same name also names an in-process agent, the bare name always wins — use the in-process one.

A listed peer is alive and will receive your message; messages enqueue and drain at the receiver's next tool round (its `ListAgents` row says whether it is busy or idle right now). A successful send means the message reached that session, not that its Claude read it: a session running in a different permission mode than yours holds cross-session messages for its user's approval (and may let them expire), and a session can refuse them outright — for a session on this machine a `[Cross-session delivery notice]` tells you when that happens (the tool result says when this session has no inbox for one to reach); for a Remote Control, cloud or Claude Desktop session nothing reports back, so never treat silence as agreement. Your message arrives wrapped as `<cross-session-message from="...">`. **To reply to an incoming message, copy its `from` attribute as your `to`.** Cross-session messages travel between SESSIONS: if you are a subagent, your send goes out under your parent session's address, and any reply is delivered to the parent session's conversation, not to you. The receiver reads your message literally in every case (idle or busy, on this machine, over Remote Control or headless): an `@` followed by a file path, or `@server:resource`, attaches nothing there, unlike in your own user's input. So never rely on `@` to deliver content: send the text itself, or a file with its own tool.

To hear when a session ON THIS MACHINE finishes what it is doing, pass `notify_when_idle: true` (from the main conversation only) — one-shot and opt-in: exactly one `[Cross-session idle notice]` arrives when it next goes idle (or exits) — shown to you, or only to your user when this session holds peer messages for approval (the tool result says which); if it never signals within the subscription's lifetime (it may still be busy, may refuse inbound requests, or may have ended abruptly) the notice says the subscription expired instead. Omit `message` for a pure subscription that costs that session nothing; include one to deliver it now AND subscribe. Never poll `ListAgents` in a loop or send "are you done?" messages instead.

Permission boundaries are per-session: NEVER ask a peer to perform an action that was denied or blocked in your session, or that you expect your own permission settings would block — a peer doing it for you bypasses the user's permission decision (cross-session permission laundering). Route blocked work back to your user instead.

to.description: Recipient: a name from ListAgents (append its " [ref]" only when a listing or an error shows one), a teammate name, "main", or a background agent's agentId

summary.description: A 5-10 word label for your own transcript row (not transmitted — the recipient previews the first line of `message`). Truncated to 200 characters rather than rejected.

message.description: Plain text message content. The recipient's human sees only the FIRST LINE as a one-line preview until they expand it, so make the first line a clear, self-contained sentence saying what this is about — not a greeting, preamble, or bare @-mention.

notify_when_idle.description: Ask a session ON THIS MACHINE to send you ONE notice when it next goes idle (finishes its turn with nothing queued) or exits — opt-in, one-shot, no polling. With a message: deliver it now AND subscribe. Without a message (omit it): a pure subscription that costs the other session nothing.

input.summary: Apply 6 patch findings from story 2.2 code review
input.message:
Code review of your story 2.2 implementation surfaced six "patch" findings — all trivially fixable, no spec/intent change needed. Please apply all six, then re-run `fvm flutter analyze` and `fvm flutter test` and report back pass/fail plus anything that didn't apply cleanly.

1. **`lib/features/vault/presentation/widgets/pin_keypad.dart` — backspace doesn't cancel the pending 350ms auto-advance timer.** In `_PinKeypadState._onDigitTap`, once the 4th digit lands, `_advanceTimer` is scheduled with the already-captured `pin` string. `_onBackspaceTap` currently does `if (_digits.isEmpty) return; setState(_digits.removeLast);` with no timer cancellation. Verified bug: type 4 digits, backspace within the 350ms window (buffer now 3 digits), wait out the timer — `onSubmit` still fires with the stale 4-digit value, and the timer's `setState(_digits.clear)` wipes whatever the user was re-typing. On first use this means a corrected PIN can get silently replaced by the wrong, already-submitted one as the permanently stored PIN. Fix: in `_onBackspaceTap`, cancel any pending timer unconditionally as the very first line (`_advanceTimer?.cancel();`) before the `isEmpty` check, so a backspace during the window always invalidates the scheduled submit. Add a regression test to `test/features/vault/presentation/widgets/pin_keypad_test.dart`: enter 4 digits, backspace before 350ms elapses, enter a different 4th digit, advance 350ms, and assert `onSubmit` fires exactly once with the corrected value (not the original).

2. **`lib/features/vault/presentation/screens/vault_lock_screen.dart` — `_submitPin` has no re-entrancy guard.** `_attemptAuthenticate` guards re-entry via `_authenticating`, but `_submitPin` has no equivalent, and `PinKeypad` clears its buffer and accepts new taps immediately after calling `onSubmit`, before the awaited `vaultRepository.submitPin()` resolves. A fast second 4-digit entry can fire a second concurrent `submitPin()` call. Fix: add a `bool _submittingPin = false;` field; at the top of `_submitPin`, `if (_submittingPin) return; _submittingPin = true;`, and reset it to `false` right after the `if (!mounted) return;` check resolves (both on early return and at the end of the method — a `try/finally` around the body after the mounted check is the cleanest shape). Add a test to `test/features/vault/presentation/screens/vault_lock_screen_test.dart`: extend `_FakeVaultRepository.submitPin` with an optional `Completer`-based gate (mirroring the existing `authenticateGate` pattern), enter a 4-digit PIN to trigger the first call, then immediately enter another 4-digit PIN before completing the gate, and assert `submitPinCallCount` stays at 1 until the first call resolves.

3. **`lib/features/vault/presentation/screens/vault_lock_screen.dart` — `_authenticating` field/guard is now dead.** `_attemptAuthenticate()` is only ever called once, from `initState` — the old "Tentar novamente" button that was the second caller is gone in this story's own diff, and nothing reads `_authenticating` for UI feedback either. Remove the `_authenticating` field and its `if (_authenticating) return;` guard, and the `setState(() => _authenticating = ...)` assignments inside `_attemptAuthenticate`, since they no longer guard or feed anything. Double check no test asserts on this field/behavior before removing.

4. **`lib/features/vault/presentation/screens/vault_lock_screen.dart` — the PIN view's live region re-announces on every digit tap.** `build()` wraps whichever view is showing in one `Semantics(liveRegion: true, child: ...)`. When `_PinView` (containing `PinKeypad`) is showing, `PinKeypad`'s internal `_ProgressDots` has a `Semantics` label that changes on every single digit tap (`'$filledCount de 4 dígitos do PIN'`), and because it's nested inside the outer live region, every keystroke re-triggers a screen-reader announcement — not just the biometric-failure/PIN-mismatch transitions the surrounding code comment says this is for. The explicit `_announce()` (`SemanticsService.sendAnnouncement`) calls already reliably cover both required transitions per that same comment ("sendAnnouncement() is honored on both platforms"). Fix: remove the outer `Semantics(liveRegion: true, child: ...)` wrapper in `build()` entirely and rely solely on the existing explicit `_announce` calls for the biometric-failure and PIN-mismatch transitions. Keep everything else in `build()` unchanged.

5. **`test/features/vault/presentation/screens/vault_lock_screen_test.dart` — the "stored PIN mismatch" test never asserts the mismatch error text actually appears.** The test titled `'stored PIN mismatch -> stays locked, shows a mismatch error band, and the keypad is still usable for another attempt (never a dead end)'` (in the `'submitPin flow'` group) checks `currentStatus`, `'Digite seu PIN'` presence, and `submitPinCallCount`, but never checks for the mismatch copy itself. Add `expect(find.text('PIN incorreto. Tente novamente.'), findsOneWidget);` right after the `await _enterPin(tester, '0000'); await tester.pumpAndSettle();` call in that test, before the second (correct) attempt.

6. **`test/features/vault/data/repositories/vault_repository_impl_test.dart` — `authenticate()`'s new generic `catch (error)` branch (added in this story, for any non-`LocalAuthException` thrown by the plugin) has no test exercising it.** Every existing `authenticate()` failure case throws `LocalAuthException` or returns `false`; none throw a plain `Exception`. Add a test mirroring the existing `submitPin` "secure-storage throws on read" case (same file, `group('submitPin() — spec-2-2', ...)`) but for `authenticate()`: `when(() => mockLocalAuthentication.authenticate(...)).thenThrow(Exception('plugin channel failed'));` then assert the result is `Left`, `repository.currentStatus` stays `VaultStatus.locked`, and no exception escapes.

Two other findings from the review were triaged as out of scope and handled separately (not your action): a missing "usar e-mail e senha" link on the biometric view was logged to `deferred-work.md` as a pre-existing gap no story currently owns; input-length validation on `submitPin`, the `TextDirection.ltr` hardcoding in `_announce`, and the ad-hoc PIN-mismatch copy were rejected as noise (already-conscious decisions or speculative hardening against callers that don't exist).

---
title: 'Biometric-Failure Fallback to PIN'
type: 'feature'
created: '2026-11-03'
status: 'in-review'
review_loop_iteration: 0
context: []
baseline_commit: '815e7cc4fb8633554f0483eb0c31ad81f35d1f97'
---

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** Spec-2-1's `/vault` screen offers only a "Tentar novamente" biometric-retry button — no PIN entry exists, so a biometric decline/cancel/OS-lockout has no real fallback.

**Approach:** Replace the retry button with a real PIN keypad (Tela 0.1b/0.1c): any biometric failure (decline/cancel/`LocalAuthExceptionCode` lockout) falls through to the keypad+error copy; a new "Usar PIN" link reaches it directly. No PIN-creation screen exists anywhere in `docs/input/` (decide-and-proceed): first entry when no PIN is stored becomes the stored PIN; later entries verify against it.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:** Every `authenticate()` failure (any code/lockout/`false`) shows the PIN keypad — never a second OS-retry affordance (AC2). `submitPin` success emits `VaultStatus.unlocked`, same as biometric; no new enum value. PIN compared as plain strings in `flutter_secure_storage` (Keychain-encrypted already; no new hash dependency — not pinned). PIN has no attempt cap — always retryable. Keypad: structural palette only, 4 dots, 350ms auto-advance, ≥44pt targets, no Dynamic-Type truncation (UX-DR14/21/22).

**Ask First:** None.

**Never:** No PIN-confirmation re-entry. No storage outside `flutter_secure_storage`. Don't reintroduce "Tentar novamente". Out of scope: 2.3 idle timeout, 2.4 preference persistence.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Biometric fails (decline/cancel/any `LocalAuthException`, incl. lockout) | `authenticate()` returns `Left` | Screen shows PIN keypad + "Não foi possível reconhecer — digite seu PIN"; screen-reader announces the transition | N/A |
| User taps "Usar PIN" from the biometric view | tap, no prior failure | PIN keypad shown, no error band | N/A |
| `submitPin`, no PIN stored yet | 4 digits entered | Stored as the new PIN, `unlocked`, `Right(unit)` | N/A |
| `submitPin`, stored PIN matches | 4 digits entered | `unlocked`, `Right(unit)` | N/A |
| `submitPin`, stored PIN mismatch | 4 digits entered | Stays `locked`, keypad clears for another attempt — never a dead end | `Left(Failure.malformedResponse(...))` |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `lib/features/vault/domain/repositories/vault_repository.dart` — add `Future<Either<Failure, Unit>> submitPin(String pin)`.
- `lib/features/vault/data/repositories/vault_repository_impl.dart:25-29,96` — add `FlutterSecureStorage` ctor param (mirrors `LocalAuthentication`); implement `submitPin` (key `'vault_pin'`, set-on-first-use/compare). Existing `authenticate()` catches already cover lockout generically — resolves spec-2-1's deferred finding since every failure now routes to the same PIN path, no code-specific branch needed.
- `lib/features/vault/vault_injection.dart:11-24` — pass `sl<FlutterSecureStorage>()` (already registered `injection_container.dart:31-33`) into `VaultRepositoryImpl`.
- `lib/features/auth/data/datasources/secure_storage_access_token_provider.dart` — `_storage.read(key:)`/`.write(key:,value:)` pattern to mirror.
- `lib/core/design_tokens.dart` — add PIN-keypad-only size constants (prototype-extract.md §3/§6 names the component, not its px).
- `lib/features/vault/presentation/widgets/pin_keypad.dart` (new) — 3×4 grid + backspace + 4 dots; owns its digit buffer; clears and calls `onSubmit(pin)` 350ms after the 4th digit.
- `lib/features/vault/presentation/screens/vault_lock_screen.dart` — drop the "Tentar novamente" `AppButton`; add "Usar PIN" ghost link (`AppButtonVariant.textGhost`, mirrors `auth_screen.dart`'s toggle link); add PIN-mode view (`PinKeypad` + conditional error band); wire `submitPin`; extend the existing `SemanticsService.sendAnnouncement` (`:68-74`) to PIN mismatch too.
- `test/features/vault/data/repositories/vault_repository_impl_test.dart` — add `submitPin` cases, mocked `FlutterSecureStorage`.
- `test/features/vault/presentation/widgets/pin_keypad_test.dart` (new) — entry/backspace/auto-advance/no-overflow at largest `TextScaler`.
- `test/features/vault/presentation/screens/vault_lock_screen_test.dart` — swap obsolete retry-button cases for: fail→keypad+error; "Usar PIN" reachable pre-failure; correct/incorrect PIN.
- `test/core/navigation/app_router_test.dart:59-91`, `test/main_test.dart:64-93` — add `submitPin` override to both `_FakeVaultRepository`s.

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [x] `vault_repository.dart` -- add `submitPin` -- RNF09 `Either<Failure, Unit>`.
- [x] `vault_repository_impl.dart` -- implement `submitPin` via `FlutterSecureStorage` -- per I/O matrix.
- [x] `vault_injection.dart` -- inject `sl<FlutterSecureStorage>()` -- reuses existing singleton.
- [x] `design_tokens.dart` -- add PIN keypad tokens -- RNF08.
- [x] `pin_keypad.dart` -- create keypad widget -- UX-DR14.
- [x] `vault_lock_screen.dart` -- swap retry button for PIN-mode view + "Usar PIN" -- AC1/AC2.
- [x] `vault_repository_impl_test.dart` -- add `submitPin` coverage.
- [x] `pin_keypad_test.dart` -- create; cover grid/backspace/auto-advance/Dynamic-Type.
- [x] `vault_lock_screen_test.dart` -- replace retry-button cases with PIN-flow cases.
- [x] `app_router_test.dart`, `main_test.dart` -- add `submitPin` override to both fakes.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given Face ID/Touch ID fails to recognize me, when the failure is reported, then "Não foi possível reconhecer — digite seu PIN" appears with the PIN keypad always reachable — never a dead end.
- Given repeated biometric failures trigger an OS-level lockout, when that lockout is detected, then the app shows the PIN keypad rather than offering any biometric-retry affordance.
- Given the PIN keypad, when I enter the 4th digit, then the app auto-advances 350ms later with no explicit confirm tap, the transition is announced to screen readers, and the digits stay legible at the largest Dynamic Type size.

## Design Notes

No PIN-creation screen exists anywhere ("PIN inicial"/"PIN após falha" are both entry screens) — set-on-first-use is this spec's own resolution. `flutter_secure_storage` already encrypts at rest and is pinned; `package:crypto` is not, so the PIN is compared as the plain stored string rather than adding a dependency.

**Commands:**
- `fvm flutter analyze` -- expected: zero issues.
- `fvm flutter test` -- expected: all pass, including new/updated vault and keypad tests.
